We’re preparing to invest serious resources in state supreme court races in partnership with Planned Parenthood Votes — because _both_ democracy and reproductive rights are being attacked. So it’s even more critical that we hit our May fundraising goal by tomorrow’s deadline. It’ll take all of us in our grassroots movement to step up and fuel our fight to protect our freedoms, **[starting with small-dollar donations from supporters like you](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85968750/476425370/-1913865780?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_mayfun_email_20240530-NDRC-Red-NDRCHQSigner_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240530-NDRC-Red-NDRCHQSigner_&utm_campaign=mayfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5NGNmYTdkLWU0MWUtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yQ3-qOTeV8qJashcAHhZpfPlnBmVnT4VikFw1pyR_UE=)** , but we want you to hear directly from Attorney General Eric Holder why we’re launching our latest partnership: | "The notion that the outcome of a case should be determined by the makeup of a court is antithetical to accepted American jurisprudence.

**"Yet that is exactly what is happening in too many state supreme courts across the country.**

"It is a result of a deleterious, years-long effort by partisan interests to turn state judiciaries into yet another political instrument to force unpopular, minority-supported policies onto the people.

**This anti-democracy campaign must be stopped."**
**– Eric H. Holder, Jr.,** 82nd Attorney General of the United States Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee
---
If we’re going to protect the very fabric of our democracy and reproductive rights, we need to do everything we can to ensure state supreme courts have justices who are dedicated to interpreting the law in a neutral way, who will adhere to precedent, and who will protect the fundamental rights of all citizens.
We know we can make a serious step toward this goal in several elections happening this year, and that’s exactly why we’re partnering with Planned Parenthood Votes.
**[But we can’t win the fight to protect our freedoms without you. Peter, we have to keep Donald Trump out of the White House, and the only way to do that is by keeping Pennsylvania blue.
**[Chip in »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240530-5?refcode=em20240530-5&recurring=1&refcode2=3123_552475_ddGwN5&akid=3123%2E552475%2EddGwN5)**
If Bob Casey loses, Democrats don’t stand a chance. Pennsylvania is the linchpin that will decide both the Senate and the White House this November.
The stakes are higher than ever before. If we’re going to protect women’s rights, workers’ rights, and the fate of our democracy, we need to do everything in our power to stop Trump from flipping this battleground red. But we can only do that with your help.

[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145147174&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1MTQ3MTc0LCJpYXQiOjE3MTcxMTc1NzcsImV4cCI6MTcxOTcwOTU3NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.eEGk9ISOeIkO3m4fQS1sk9vCaQprekqcIKW8sysoOAg)
There's something special about Donald Trump making history today, May 30, 2024, as the first former President in US history to be convicted of a crime--and it isn't just that he is first. Remarkably, 97 years ago On This Day in 1927, Fred Trump, the father of former President Donald Trump, [was arrested for rallying with the KKK](https://substack.com/redirect/9ceaa53c-73a5-4c2f-b327-c76af3695e85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) white supremacist terrorist organization.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..PuVbLhvKmBGhh2-TAwJkes5gEuwU5L5qG3XU6f9KNyc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145147174)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0d1598fd-9eb7-41ba-a6c1-b27dd7a834a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fred Trump [Credit: Trumpfile.Org]
Fast forward 97 years, and on May 30, 2024, Fred's son Donald has been convicted of 34 felonies in a Manhattan court--on every count for which he was accused. Side note: Wikipedia works fast, as Donald Trump's page was updated in seconds.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/177201a6-cb7d-46eb-88e9-b09bcc985d65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Donald Trump's Wikipedia Page
The poetic justice is almost palpable. In the very state where Donald Trump once took out a full-page ad to falsely accuse five Black and brown youths of a crime and call for their death, he now faces the music for his own misdeeds. (Meanwhile, one of those exonerated five, [Yusef Salaam](https://substack.com/redirect/16ec037c-e5f3-4574-b5c5-19cc4659aabd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is a beloved and elected City Council member in New York City).
But let's dive into what this conviction means.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f9b9c57c-6463-4122-b2be-a06266a183c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Donald Trump's public ad calling for execution of the Exonerated Five.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..PuVbLhvKmBGhh2-TAwJkes5gEuwU5L5qG3XU6f9KNyc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145147174)
**First, let 's be perfectly clear**--Donald Trump's conviction is not the result of a grand conspiracy by Biden, Clinton, Soros, Big Bird, Target, Wokeness, Disney, the pride flag, CRT, or DEI. Donald Trump was convicted by his fellow U.S. citizens under due process, as required by the U.S. Constitution. This isn't a partisan victory or a cultural battleground score; it's justice served by the very system he alleges to champion when he calls himself the "[Law & Order Candidate](https://substack.com/redirect/81858e39-1b49-453e-bb8d-db5880fa70b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
**Likewise, let 's also debunk the myth** that convicting Donald Trump is extreme, political, or "third world" as some MAGA Republicans have described it. In reality, convicting a former head of state for demonstrable criminal acts after due process of law isn't unique in the world, and certainly not in developed democracies. By holding Donald Trump accountable for his crimes, the United States joins the ranks of dozens of nations, including many developed democracies, that ensure their leaders are not above the law. In fact, [since 2000](https://substack.com/redirect/1c982587-19b9-4360-95c3-88c5d34f007e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at least 78 nations have prosecuted or jailed their leaders after they left office, including U.S. allies like France, Israel, Taiwan, and South Korea. Trump's New York conviction signals to the world that at least in this case, the United States is serious about the rule of law, regardless of the defendant's status or former office.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5857fa71-423c-460c-bcac-324d0c8f9033?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Moreover, the Supreme Court cannot grant Trump immunity** from this conviction, nor can a future President. This is because Trump has been convicted in state court, and if there's one thing Republicans love, it is "States' Rights." The very principles they hold dear now ensure that justice is not obstructed. While New York Governor Hochul has the power to grant him clemency, her disdain for Donald Trump notwithstanding, I highly doubt she'd willingly engage in such political suicide.
**And finally, as a convicted felon, chances are Donald Trump cannot vote** in the upcoming election in Florida. Only two states allow incarcerated felons to vote, and Florida is not among them. In fact, let alone the ban on voting for incarcerated felons, Governor Desantis has gone out of his way [to make voting a near impossibility for former felons](https://substack.com/redirect/62f6397a-07be-4734-9a90-1ccf2670c9ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even those who have already served their time.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e2eac3d8-4138-449f-b110-ddcb66ac9b8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Former President Donald Trump leaves the courthouse after a jury found him guilty of all 34 felony counts in his criminal trial at Manhattan Criminal Court, Thursday, May 30, 2024, in New York. (Justin Lane/Pool Photo via AP)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..PuVbLhvKmBGhh2-TAwJkes5gEuwU5L5qG3XU6f9KNyc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145147174)
**Oh, and one last thing --will Trump face prison time?** We'll find out soon enough. Donald Trump will be sentenced for these 34 convictions on July 11, where he faces 0 to 4 years for each count. Any sentencing would run concurrently so his punishment could range from probation and no prison to up to 4 years in prison. But his troubles don't end there. As CBS News [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/2bff87da-8458-4260-bde5-92d76fa3faad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Trump is still facing charges in two cases brought in federal courts in South Florida and Washington, D.C., by special counsel Jack Smith and one prosecution in state court led by Fulton County, Georgia, District Attorney Fani Willis.
In other words, Trump's legal troubles, and likely criminal convictions, are only just getting started.
**In short, the conviction of Donald Trump serves as a testament** to one aspect of American democracy--the principle that no one, not even a former president, is above the law. Still, what a strange situation that a man convicted of felonies that manipulated an election, while unable to vote in future elections, can still run for office and be elected? We shall see if this conviction hurts, helps, or makes no difference on Donald Trump's chances to win in November. For now, my gratitude to the New York Jury who valiantly and courageously fulfilled their civic duty, delivered due process of law, and reminded us all that this country's head of state is indeed a President accountable to the law, not a dictator who is above the law.
At least not yet.

---
Friends, when I joined the Marines I signed up to serve my country.

I’m the child of immigrants, the first generation. This country gave me everything, and I felt like I needed to give back. I swore to defend our Constitution, our democracy, from all enemies — foreign and domestic.

But when I signed up, I never thought this was how things would end up.

Over the last several years the most insidious threats to our Constitution have emerged at home. It’s people like Donald Trump and his “MAGA Queen” Kari Lake — openly advocating for violence and repression, tearing down our elections, laying the groundwork for dictatorship and authoritarian rule.

If they win, it could mean the end of our Republic. I’m sorry to say this, but it can happen here. We can stop them, but it’s going to take a ton of hard work. And Arizona will be the frontline in the fight for our democracy.

If we’re going to win, if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, and if we’re going to stop Trump from winning back the White House, I need your help. | Peter,

In 2016, after witnessing the devastating impact of wildfires and the loss of millions of acres of our precious forests, I knew I had to act. That’s why I ran for Commissioner of Public Lands—to keep Washington State, the Evergreen State, truly evergreen.

Through the Keep Washington Evergreen Initiative, we've restored over 600,000 acres of forestlands, prevented countless wildfires, and conserved nearly 200,000 acres of forest. But the challenges we face extend beyond our state. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the nation, from wildfires and droughts to deadly heat waves and flooding.

I'm running for Congress to take my bold vision and relentless commitment to climate action to Congress. The challenges our environment and communities face require nothing short of EPIC goals and EPIC progress. _That's why I'm running to take my bold vision and relentless commitment to advancing climate action, abortion rights, affordable housing, and so much more._

But, I can’t do this alone. **As we approach our critical end-of-month goal tomorrow at midnight, I need your support to ensure my vision reaches every voter in Washington’s 6th Congressional District.** We’re gearing up for a heated election in August, and your contribution is vital to our success.

| Dear Peter, ,
Dear Fellow Republicans,As your State Chairman, I am compelled to address the recent travesty of justice that has unfolded in New York. The sham verdict in the rigged trial against President Donald Trump is an affront to our republic and the principles of fairness that our nation was founded upon. This politically motivated attack is a blatant attempt to undermine a leader who has tirelessly championed the American people.
We cannot stand idly by as the left continues their relentless assault on our values and leaders. It is imperative that we, as members of the Republican Party of Nebraska, take a stand and show our unwavering support for President Trump.
[**Please chip in $10, $25, $50, $100, or more to help me and our fellow Republicans PUSH BACK against the Left's corruption of our justice system and their attack on our democracy.**](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=dff777e8ca&e=25844e23a8)
Here’s how you can take action:
1\. Get Involved: Join our grassroots efforts to mobilize and energize voters across Nebraska. Volunteer your time and talents to help ensure a strong Republican turnout on November 5th. Contact [resources@ne.gop](mailto:resources@ne.gop?subject=I'm%20all%20in!&body=) and say “I’m all in” to support President Trump! 2\. [Support the NEGOP](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=950a5776d3&e=25844e23a8): Your contributions are crucial in our fight to defeat Democratic candidates at every level. Consider donating to support our efforts in securing victories for Republican candidates who will stand up against the left’s radical agenda.
3\. Stay Informed and Spread the Word: Share the truth about the injustice President Trump is facing. Use your voice on social media, in your communities, and within your circles to counter the false narratives being pushed by the opposition. **Follow us on Facebook, Twitter (X), or join our email list by going to our website**[**https://www.ne.gop**](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2478b8a54a&e=25844e23a8)
Our collective efforts can and will make a difference. This is a pivotal moment for our party and our nation. Together, we can ensure that the principles of liberty, justice, and the rule of law prevail.
Stand strong, stay united, and let’s show the Democrats that their tactics will not succeed. Join us in this crucial fight to protect our values and support President Trump.
Thank you for your dedication and commitment to our cause.
---

This is my biggest goal yet — and it's our final end-of-month goal before we head into end-of-quarter next month. I knew that hitting this goal wouldn't be easy. But I'm not afraid of a tough fight, and Florida deserves a senator who will never back down. Will you let me explain? = Growing up, my older sisters were fearless. As a young immigrant from Ecuador, new to America and struggling to find a community here, I needed advocates and role models exactly like them. Through lessons and by example, they taught me to always stand up for myself no matter what, whether I was facing schoolyard bullies or the teacher who refused to call on me because of my accent. My sisters and my mom have always been my fiercest advocates. They showed me what it meant to work hard, how to fight for the future you deserve, and when to stand up and say ya no más — enough is enough. I've carried their lessons with me my entire life, inspiring me to take on bullies in both the halls of my high school and the halls of Congress. And right now, Florida families have a bully as a senator. Rick Scott only cares about three things: his interests, his far-right agenda, and his massive fortune. He's spent his time in the Senate attacking programs that help working families, pushing dangerous and out-of-touch policies, lying to voters, and promoting Trump's lies. I'm sick and tired of watching Rick Scott bully Florida families and push our state backward. Ya no más. I'm running to show this bully that Floridians deserve strong leadership and a brighter future. ---
Dear Peter,
Change Starts With You
Democracy is happening all across America as thousands gather signatures to put Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. on the ballot in November.
And in New York this week, thousands helped Kennedy for President turn in an unprecedented 135,000+ signatures– nearly guaranteeing our spot on ballot, assuming NY election officials follow the law!
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=3)
“This accomplishment is a testament to the strength of our movement,” said Emma Diment, Kennedy campaign field digital director. “We’ve talked with hundreds of thousands of New York voters who are thrilled to have an alternative to the status-quo this November.”
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=4)
The campaign’s aggressive [ballot access](https://www.kennedy24.com/ballot-access?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=5) plan will ensure the Kennedy-Shanahan ticket is on the ballot in all 50 states and the District of Columbia.
The Kennedy-Shanahan ticket is officially on the ballot in seven states — [Utah](https://www.kennedy24.com/bobby_on_the_ballot_rfk_jr_utah_ballot?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=6), [Michigan](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_michigan?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=7), [California](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy-shanahan_california_ballot?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=8), [Delaware](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_access_delaware?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=9), [Oklahoma](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_oklahoma?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=10), [Hawaii](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_campaign_wins_dnc_ballot_access_challenge?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=11), and [Texas](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_shanahan_ballot_access_texas?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=12). It has collected enough signatures for ballot access in nine other states — [New Hampshire](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_campaign_nh_signatures_ballot_access?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=13), [Nevada](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_signatures_nevada?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=14), [North Carolina](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_access_north_carolina?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=15), [Idaho](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_access_idaho?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=16), [Nebraska](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_access_nebraska?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=17), [Iowa](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_ballot_access_iowa_state_convention?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=18), [Ohio](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_signatures_ballot_access_ohio?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=19), [New Jersey](https://www.kennedy24.com/kennedy_collects_signatures_gain_ballot_access_new_jersey?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=20), and now New York.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=21)
The Kennedy-Shanahan campaign has collected the signatures needed for ballot access in 16 states, totaling 229 electoral votes, 43% of the 538 total electoral votes nationwide.
“Getting ‘Bobby on the Ballot’ in my home state is one of the greatest achievements of my life,” said New York volunteer Tammi Palmeri. “I understand what’s at stake for our country and I’m grateful there’s a candidate I can believe in.”
The movement and the momentum we’re building is growing stronger and stronger, day by day.
The words “Thank You” don’t seem to do it justice–but those words are true.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=empire_state_5_30_24_a1&n=22)
We are deeply thankful for all of your hard work, the long hours standing, knocking on doors, for the countless conversations and interactions you have had with many thousands of voters in your state.
It’s all paying off, and our campaign –especially our ground game–continues to outperform all expectations.
And we have you to thank!
Again, you make it all possible. We love you, and we are grateful.
Team Kennedy

body:
#
The (first) criminal trial of Donald Trump concluded today.
The MAGA movement spent weeks decrying the process as a political stunt, a partisan effort to stifle Trump’s second presidential campaign.
But a jury of everyday New Yorkers — folks carefully screened by Trump’s own team for partisanship – **found Trump guilty of all 34 charges against him**.
Our justice system does not often treat all people equally. Too often, poor and marginalized communities across the country are incriminated for crimes that the wealthy and powerful easily escape accountability for.
**Today, we took a step closer to a world in which the rule of law applies to everybody, equally.**
[Alexandria knows that we cannot win social and economic justice for all of us without first fighting the corruption in our systems. Will you make a $5 contribution today to power her campaign for transformative change?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240530.TnDkWK&refcode=em20240530-6526-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6526%2E2526796%2EwjNYkp)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240530.TnDkWK&refcode=em20240530-6526-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6526%2E2526796%2EwjNYkp)**
Trump will surely explore all of his legal avenues to challenge the verdict. Within minutes of leaving the courtroom today, he started fundraising off of his conviction:
But Alexandria is not afraid to combat the lies, hatred, and disinformation coming from the MAGA movement.
And while Trump tries to buy his way back into the White House with the money of those he’s swindled, **we know that our lives, our wages, our healthcare, and our families are worth fighting for this November**.
[Alexandria is fighting for a better world for all of us, not just a wealthy few. And because she accepts no contributions from corporations or special interests, she works only for us. Can you chip in $5 today to keep her in Congress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240530.TnDkWK&refcode=em20240530-6526-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=6526%2E2526796%2EwjNYkp)

We will keep you posted as Trump’s legal situation develops. Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: Hillsdale College via ICYMI News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjiopuicr34t7ld56ndfkrmcg6sejhi9vb1mmcdg_rp22sh2s8i6ep37chimcoj6cph2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$500, $250, $100, $50, $25, or $10 to launch the next, crucial
phase for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, Joe Biden, and Big Labor to bury the National
Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $250, $500, and
even more. For others, a contribution of $25 or $50 has been as
much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $500, $250,
$100, $50, $25, or $10, the National Right to Work Committee
won't be able to contact 10 million Americans, place the
advertising, deploy the whole digital program, or do anything
else to put Big Labor on the spot with a public vote on the
National Right to Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then pitch in with your
contribution of $500, $250, $100, $50, $25, or $10 to the
National Right to Work Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $500, $250, $100,
$50, $25, or $10 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

## Trump Found Guilty by New York Jury
A New York jury found former President Donald Trump [guilty on 34 counts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGngY0IDjB0YOjiLV07WgSfAxE2ET67yttX6dz5Hz7p_75O11hq2e5fccVAS5tionLiZIVWAsxk-BwWREDNMSinnLJ--ACeg1c2auO1HqxclI8maesWZZJe0s0Zw0sACUZaraS3A8Bl8FYaP2t0iBLVwIzEuVDrl0crG2Vc6qud2C-prbyGTPTcmf5kMDIYKWMutb4bg7Hj_aiRStsYjKkdncQtElXcGYzmDUknHkd_iY4xZdzFiX0uiQT1Y32KfOxZrG3Dl6BeYmUw8h7m50-pteyDY0be11j-OE7_jzkD_AYAAP__bWNlsw) of falsifying business records, making him the first president to be prosecuted and convicted of a felony. The verdict came after less than 12 hours of deliberation. Trump addressed reporters immediately after, saying he was innocent and the real verdict would come on Nov. 5 when people vote for president. Trump remains free and won't face any travel restrictions--at least until sentencing, which is [scheduled for July 11.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd0QwYJsUFK-hy2u3tGwYx6wwIDOxlb9fZett75WOjs7XY3rMMcX8_D_vaGkt0-wpnjj1XEkOetJdsCsioOrQylGOsjfDHbrNBgCv_Qqr1hLAwLCouw_BLCEsBkfdRQsCtOiVFKYfAG6D6YU2QeGIKFAOTAsMkcpx-y4x04ZrepcTj5sve5fsRlQbU_8YOAYuv2tp9LkYuA-YgRM9A6cEA_dqPOPVGLgND2z82mbi21wr5sZzuTh9Bjpee218Qczcl3xGTxgYuO6woV4xpdiGkWnx3OeYfi3o7yanhZ8AAAD__1lpYww) His lawyers will likely seek a probationary sentence while they appeal the case. If that first appeal fails, he can appeal further to the state's highest court, which could take another year.
## SCOTUS Rules 9-0 in Favor of NRA
The Supreme Court [unanimously ruled Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAUhJ8Gd1iHw4-dguI2dLntlhbCh4RdbCxMYvntV0693Wj0STP6vu7T3aec1sd_v5BtsUw-tPSmSXMpOKpJdbONREiyIysGMQg9mht2T3uLEoOUA3oTbyqAJJhHA1EoGYOedZcsAirQUsCoDWJvRg1qnCUNREDCMAU0p1Zq_13S2p4U81neVPtQli7bZ2vbzuQ_ho6hO46jf-2-ldmfF8DQ7a3Uk6Fb6dgZuq3k1FK44jXM0IFm6CRc6GurtBAP5VUbX31LZfWZ1xQzcb_vJaRPx1c6-FnqD0M3SCGMBgUwMHRdtfN2pJzTbgam4LH4lD9P29_e3hZ_AwAA___iz226) in favor of the National Rifle Association, saying the group could sue a New York state official for violating the NRA's First Amendment rights. The opinion, [written by Justice Sonia Sotomayor](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7ojWCzZQUFyTLtdeaa1hibnDxsI40f39U179ytE0o_nzmB-Uctqfv2lj12KZybf04nkUchCoZtUHF5mRZc9u0IMeRjNZ7FdnkElPMiLpxfpglAWkASwsZM2ioU8OARWMcgAzToi3yYygTJCsmYGHqVPAIbVSb39L2tvKMf8vL643X7Y-u7W14-zkrw7vHd7p2Pl9ftQHaks-c4f3vZIgny9xUP2XaQ_iXEtpaX-KTO_zSk2c11F5Y-HLVZuwo1SoooxByojaLuA9eoYRYLJBmb66cLxTzumcdKfguVHK30Xt5z8vh18BAAD__3GJZt4), vacated a lower court's ruling that dismissed the NRA's 2018 lawsuit against Maria Vullo, a former superintendent of New York's Department of Financial Services. The organization claimed Vullo coerced banks and insurers to blackball the NRA in the wake of the 2018 Parkland High School shooting. Thursday's ruling found that the [NRA "plausibly alleged"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2SrCAUBOCn0exYcPjRCQhuYjY33dBCPIzsoliAY83bb83Em3TQnXzVX_fpbkMM--O_3chUnybranjSpEBwQDnJdjGeCEm0ZHjPe64GfcN2NRxnx3tltRQ35-3sbkr6mSNKad2g-zYYZCiZEpwNSiN2elBMDougnogR141ktISacvedwl5X8vGVnpQ7l7Y2mrXWozTiX4Njg-N1XV2ms1Iu7_3dpByXBsezfALKeWTaCFw6c4U5pVIL7NmCz0RQDiK3gg-PtcIV6go7XfBK-QeS98EFG-HtBaZAsAbHNpvluEKMoei-keyx2RA_tPr3UU-DvwEAAP__wuRrNg) Vullo selectively wielded her power to punish or suppress the organization's speech, and it cleared the way for the gun rights group to continue to argue its case in the lower courts.
## Israel Takes Control of Gaza Border
Israel's military has taken control over the Gaza Strip's [entire land border,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu9CAQBOCnwR0WLNj4Coq_obu_TWntmeVMhM0JyFnO00dOnXb0STOaj_t8x5ji_vyPG9kW8oxLi2-aB64kBz3rzttABKQ6stJII4dpvEG32iAlaiOUetDNKDKkAYIPEB4LXXkXLQjQYlBSTMMI0I_TIPTkL0uC5Mi0IB9bLv1njntbKaQzv6n0S966ZNfWXpWpfwwcA3ccR_9VsWWP5wUYuNpyORm4nY56iVySZ-CuVgZODAycEgxcrAUp8Rcmqi3uEffKV9yw8gMLf-I38oIBV77kvZWcGDijbkLJSQlhGLiuWP86YkqxjoZp8dwwpt-V7e_P3hZ-AgAA__9AGmwg) including the buffer zone separating the enclave from Egypt, as it deepens its assault on Rafah. U.S., Israeli, and Egyptian officials plan to [meet next week in Cairo](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FugzAQQL_GbEbnwzYweOjiLV07IoMPcpUTI-OGpl9fpXPnJ72n93GZLoET37f3cCNX1zyFpfKDJiM7JVFPuoluJULqGnKqV70ygx2xuToiO4zjbCzhvIQAozEKdexhnJc-KGjYIaAG0ykYjEVs7WBAD7GjnghIWaGBItdc2s_M93qlNT3zg0q75FuT3LXW_RDdm0Av0J_n2YZvzseLCvQvt0APRqDvQKD_OmReV144pEPWwruk7blXOecSqcgt_ISmuLifnBIfthcatlvg9Fer_78_HP4GAAD__xUGWi0) to discuss strategies for securing that border and reopening it for aid shipments while preventing Hamas from smuggling weapons across it. Israel meanwhile continued to investigate the strike that killed scores of civilians in a camp in Rafah. Military officials say Israel used the smallest bombs their jets can carry and that the fire may have been caused by the [explosion of a Hamas ammo dump](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGngW6QfzEULm5Dt7dNiQweLxMZvLK9IPL0UVKnP9KRvo_H_HAU6Xj-dzvaGtLs1konzhokB6Fm1XobEAXKFi033HA99KNoN4vGLKhHzaVko1HLwrRZ5WD4gkGMvW_JCiYU05KzQfdCdP2gmRq8RIPIkPeNYuipptx9JjrqhiHe6cTcrWlvo91qfZVG_mvE1Ijpuq6u0o4lBSrZYfypGjGRD1DcXWAj7_GAUlNGSAEq5pwy7O-DKqWjwO5u2NyJsLp3QQ8enY83ZBfcBkt0X9iIqc3Wvy6KkUpvGsWeu6PfVVv_5jmt-A4AAP__85lpxw) nearby.

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Elections Have Consequences_**
---
Friends, As we work toward the November elections, it's important to reflect on the incredible progress Indiana has made under Republican leadership. We've seen amazing achievements and exciting projects that have positively impacted our state's economy and job market. By continuing to support strong Republican leaders, we can keep this momentum going and ensure a prosperous future for all Hoosiers.

Our state has been lucky to have strong Republican leadership for 20+ years. Governor Holcomb, alongside the Indiana General Assembly, have created a business environment that has seen unprecedented investments in infrastructure, innovation, and global partnerships. These efforts have led to the creation of thousands of jobs, enhanced public safety, and attracted significant private investments - **_making Indiana a better place to live, work, and play!_** To maintain and build upon our state's recent success, it is vital to elect Republican leaders who will continue to prioritize the needs of everyday Hoosiers. The next election is not just about a candidate; it is a vote for the continued progress and well-being of our communities!

_**Together, let's secure a brighter future for Indiana by supporting and electing Republican leaders!**_

Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---

# _Gov. Holcomb Alongside Toyota Broke Ground on a New Forklift Facility _
---
---

Today’s remarkable announcement shows yet again just how important our state’s business friendly environment – focus on long-term success and access to a skilled workforce – is to companies seeking to expand and grow far into the future.” \- **Gov. # 🚀📈 The Hoosier Economy Won't Slow Down! 💪
---
Between Memorial Day and the Indy 500, it’s been a crazy couple of weeks for the Hoosier state! Republican leadership in the General Assembly and the Governor's office have been able to build a business environment in Indiana that has been able to attract record investments and job opportunities that will continue to propel our economy forward. **Keep in mind what these new announcements mean for communities across the state. There are real benefits behind these numbers that allow Hoosier families to thrive in Indiana. These investments mean more jobs, higher wages, and more opportunities for all Hoosiers. ** Below are some of the major announcements that have happened in Indiana over the last couple of weeks. **[The South Shore Line Double Track Project](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1f9d2af66cd9ed983947229f28c3afba/9949226332b3d2f2c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** Northwest Indiana is booming! The transformative Double Track project, which was on time and under budget, and $950 million West Lake Corridor initiative will inject $2.7 billion in private investment, create over 6,000 jobs, and significantly reduce travel times with 18 miles of new track and 14 additional weekday trains. **This investment will further revitalize the region and attract new businesses and residents.** **[Elevate Ventures Growth Stage Fund](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1f9d2af66cd9ed983947229f28c3afba/6540ba7c48f7f714c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** Governor Holcomb announced the Elevate Ventures Growth Fund, a new $100M initiative targeting high-potential, growth-stage companies with a $500M+ market. Anchored by a $25M investment from Elevate Ventures, with an additional $75M to be raised privately, this fund aims to propel Indiana's venture capital scene, following the state's record-breaking $1 billion venture activity in 2021-2022. **This strategic investment will drive innovation, create high-paying jobs, and foster a robust entrepreneurial ecosystem in Indiana.** **[Purdue-Elanco Research Facility ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1f9d2af66cd9ed983947229f28c3afba/cbadf037bae7f9c5c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** The OneHealth Innovation District partnership between Purdue University and Elanco Animal Health **will create new jobs, boost local economies, and improve public health through cutting-edge research**. This collaboration enhances educational opportunities for students and researchers, preparing them for advanced careers in biosciences and related fields. **[Eli Lilly’s Additional $5.3 Billion Investment ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/1f9d2af66cd9ed983947229f28c3afba/4496fe706c43d8d7c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** Governor Holcomb and Eli Lilly announced a $5.3 billion expansion, doubling Lilly's investment in the LEAP Research and Innovation District to $9 billion. This expansion will enhance Lilly's capacity to manufacture active pharmaceutical ingredients for diabetes and obesity medicines, creating 200 new high-skilled jobs and bringing the total planned new jobs at LEAP to 900. **The investment solidifies Indiana's position as a hub for global innovation, leveraging state-of-the-art technology and creating significant economic growth and job opportunities for Hoosiers. **** ** These announcements are just a few more examples of how Republican leadership has made Indiana one of the best states in the country to live, work, and play. Investments and projects such as these give Hoosiers more opportunities, build more wealth, and transform communities.

body:
Are you struggling with a difficult question in your life?

| | | This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GzL8ADrc7irykV1o1OUX2Q~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Knowledge, Are you struggling with a difficult question in your life? Often, I find myself in that position as well. It’s part of the human condition to be faced with difficult situations, choices, and people. We teach at Hillsdale College that we must carefully consider concepts such as morality, ethics, happiness, courage, character, and justice when we face difficult questions. In the _Nicomachean Ethics_ —the first book written on how best to live—Aristotle argues that human happiness chiefly depends upon a person’s character, which is formed by making good choices. But good choices don’t come naturally. That’s why every student at Hillsdale studies Aristotle. In fact, understanding Aristotle is so important to living a good life that we’ve produced our online course, **“Introduction to Aristotle’s _Ethics_ : How to Lead a Good Life.” **
---
| | And now you can own the course on DVD, along with a special Hillsdale College edition of Aristotle’s _Nicomachean Ethics_ , for personal study. You’ll not only study what Aristotle says about the good life with Hillsdale College President Larry P. Arnn, but you will also explore ways to put this knowledge to work.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GzL8ADrc7irykV1o1OUX2Q~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | The DVD gives you a seat at the table in a seminar-style class like those here on campus, and you’ll read from the same book the students are in the course. In addition to the topics I’ve already mentioned, the course focuses on subjects including:
* Aristotle’s _Politics_ and the Nature of Man
* Deliberation and Choice
* Practical Judgment
* Contemplation and Action

Just consider what Rebecca, a free online course student, recently said: _“I have learned [through the Aristotle course] that every choice we make etches into our soul.”_ Make a good choice, and watch a special preview video of the course. Then reserve your DVD and book today using this secure link: [**_https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/aristotle-dvd-book-offer_**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GzL8ADrc7irykV1o1OUX2Q~~/AARclAA~~~) After watching the preview, if you’re struggling with a thorny question, I hope you’ll join Rebecca and many others by reserving your DVD of [**“Introduction to Aristotle’s _Ethics_ ”**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GzL8ADrc7irykV1o1OUX2Q~~/AARclAA~~~)**** along with its companion book __ today _._ Quantities of the DVD and book are limited, so don’t wait too long to decide. name: Hillsdale College via Defend the Constitution
subject: Our nation’s history is unifying
body:
American history!

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c70de5b2df444326b31db2d8b25f5670&_e=9bC6Hg_R5MVpZya8qiYxKSRdhyVw7jAZ90p3z5q8flCxKliJDMRRNHgx4g84GWpbOaYkbxYitlgdvI7O3VCcFuN45XCvziSmGwT2I0wxWWuQDHHStPln_pZgJUAw3QTHVkK8f8QaYXMo1cqG3JkZAX6-TXd0pteKf1SmGeonKjSJtpSXPJXW9IJ20PMP6W7G5C5NyoVrd0kgHkQiRHaVvmPMPxKRwvImPUhCReZo8Mwmu5Oni7qqcBztERRRtHsK1RRQuC_gATK9rNn8d1dX7mMe3ZPzYfi9QLC3vCIov9RHRryQOGMYcWMAJpam7GHuXBGleGcEyJg0GSGUIL_OPIfA8jiydScoCPepPU8i_4uNbSqCuujEO_IC1jvrRt0-yPcnqgsYeIaK049zN0ckepJKvULtjFXyfTm2NBMmA7w%3D) Dear Fellow American, Thanks for opening my email. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c70de5b2df444326b31db2d8b25f5670&_e=9bC6Hg_R5MVpZya8qiYxKSRdhyVw7jAZ90p3z5q8flCxKliJDMRRNHgx4g84GWpbOaYkbxYitlgdvI7O3VCcFuN45XCvziSmGwT2I0wxWWuQDHHStPln_pZgJUAw3QTHVkK8f8QaYXMo1cqG3JkZAX6-TXd0pteKf1SmGeonKjSJtpSXPJXW9IJ20PMP6W7G5C5NyoVrd0kgHkQiRHaVvmPMPxKRwvImPUhCReZo8Mwmu5Oni7qqcBztERRRtHsK1RRQuC_gATK9rNn8d1dX7qkc5zqaYAdUScUTJY8TTcx3zUdor8IWo316p-WbeHFZuVLOAOIyYS0Pf7rEba-nnKxS_eFQragOiXWw-pAxOa--tHhMKEEPhNe2nDFiW52T96C7jUicnTvDpvD99I1kaAz88T6EiBmtV3kX1LwXlfE%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c70de5b2df444326b31db2d8b25f5670&_e=9bC6Hg_R5MVpZya8qiYxKSRdhyVw7jAZ90p3z5q8flCxKliJDMRRNHgx4g84GWpbOaYkbxYitlgdvI7O3VCcFuN45XCvziSmGwT2I0wxWWuQDHHStPln_pZgJUAw3QTHVkK8f8QaYXMo1cqG3JkZAX6-TXd0pteKf1SmGeonKjSJtpSXPJXW9IJ20PMP6W7G5C5NyoVrd0kgHkQiRHaVvmPMPxKRwvImPUhCReZo8Mwmu5Oni7qqcBztERRRtHsK1RRQuC_gATK9rNn8d1dX7qiskh8axS01SbgMbm0kdp3PmKp6PGzNmAf7zFm-FGQGnOBRS_Y6ujRDNM_x9BylnD4il-Tz_wGws00HEEbdwYCrXwyWMlsxSM6oSjgjoUoTAF0LC4PFv6yT2v2Q4rNCpGmUrHe-wumR8BnQxrRyMaU%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Today, you can claim a DVD copy of ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c70de5b2df444326b31db2d8b25f5670&_e=9bC6Hg_R5MVpZya8qiYxKSRdhyVw7jAZ90p3z5q8flCxKliJDMRRNHgx4g84GWpbOaYkbxYitlgdvI7O3VCcFuN45XCvziSmGwT2I0wxWWuQDHHStPln_pZgJUAw3QTHVkK8f8QaYXMo1cqG3JkZAX6-TXd0pteKf1SmGeonKjSJtpSXPJXW9IJ20PMP6W7G5C5NyoVrd0kgHkQiRHaVvmPMPxKRwvImPUhCReZo8Mwmu5Oni7qqcBztERRRtHsK1RRQuC_gATK9rNn8d1dX7hCm6ecUxXLhdGGREfE5S0WTyBMO21pxLnarH8WLDdGaJD3NaRBV1ARgSGozJ4yQel_-fdPLcTp1rSGHSyak9-H9LLTqtV7jb-CBGC-bpXk34kQvhkFzG7gsJ-6tIxHj7D20hR1X9_0EbLNt6u7xAI4%3D) for your home library or give it as a gift. **Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty.** Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c70de5b2df444326b31db2d8b25f5670&_e=9bC6Hg_R5MVpZya8qiYxKSRdhyVw7jAZ90p3z5q8flCxKliJDMRRNHgx4g84GWpbOaYkbxYitlgdvI7O3VCcFuN45XCvziSmGwT2I0wxWWuQDHHStPln_pZgJUAw3QTHVkK8f8QaYXMo1cqG3JkZAX6-TXd0pteKf1SmGeonKjSJtpSXPJXW9IJ20PMP6W7G5C5NyoVrd0kgHkQiRHaVvmPMPxKRwvImPUhCReZo8Mwmu5Oni7qqcBztERRRtHsK1RRQuC_gATK9rNn8d1dX7gNNKz73UD5VHdMLpvNmUS0DdQ-EiGhUn0BkBFWFwoLVYA7JjrB95HEtDo1Wih6IDoq5myGd6xjXkCnkHmzYtweaGUiXq-B1HnpxYFfUT7-WjUoKtrTJ5h0WleodyADeKQ5ZUd2ATU6SGQSIG88xSgY%3D) Thank you for your partnership with Hillsdale College and for supporting its mission on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College **P.S.** Despite what _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project" says, our nation's history is unifying. That's why we've produced a full, unbiased account of America's past with **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"** now available on DVD. You can receive your copy with your generous tax-deductible gift of $100 or more using this secure link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c70de5b2df444326b31db2d8b25f5670&_e=9bC6Hg_R5MVpZya8qiYxKSRdhyVw7jAZ90p3z5q8flCxKliJDMRRNHgx4g84GWpbOaYkbxYitlgdvI7O3VCcFuN45XCvziSmGwT2I0wxWWuQDHHStPln_pZgJUAw3QTHVkK8f8QaYXMo1cqG3JkZAX6-TXd0pteKf1SmGeonKjSJtpSXPJXW9IJ20PMP6W7G5C5NyoVrd0kgHkQiRHaVvmPMPxKRwvImPUhCReZo8Mwmu5Oni7qqcBztERRRtHsK1RRQuC_gATK9rNn8d1dX7r_cTPgrQnkBy3jb36ZHc1y8ZMqHj-LbWWzukajThvfPzqwYRjsUYrUFJV-py3AqAAJZGu7-5z3GgpsikmxS_oxPY8ZG6YsdmJwDkwEHgy-FQrw-aPmw8rR7EHRlGEC7njJVg9CkxiKpgNUVguDc26E%3D) Act today because quantities are limited! Thank you so much for helping us promote intelligent patriotism--especially among younger Americans. |

As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to The New York Times ' "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. That 's why we've turned our online course, into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy. " The Great American Story: A Land of Hope" presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that " The Great American Story: A Land of Hope" is a powerful counterweight to The New York Times ' "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Today, you can claim a DVD copy of for your home library or give it as a gift. Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty. Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. Thank you for your partnership with Hillsdale College and for supporting its mission on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College P.S. Despite what The New York Times ' "1619 Project" says, our nation's history is unifying. That's why we've produced a full, unbiased account of America's past with " The Great American Story: A Land of Hope," now available on DVD. You can receive your copy with your generous tax-deductible gift of $100 or more using this secure link: Act today because quantities are limited! Thank you so much for helping us promote intelligent patriotism--especially among younger Americans. | | Defend the Constitution PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a025ed2ec6d45af96b582d7d9a61395&_e=4vhap73vLk4fMb-Y10rIYdjPRscCQeBUVNTy_vZ9-cEE-i2qOmmYWFbZw5K6WS3QlgMcKMv6kcCg_aICHCJKBFjkEK4XJC1-6JTUJmVYOcKZ02hh1eKBnfKbWhRrIWZphihx6JO65f_xInyTaUtPFdSyiM1QaYMljYo76biKkyRzpNyY1acuXe1JB0698pPP2-ftTfnDRh-auSCw1BxAKl-tljFPCP_J91R6g-6p0f1qQKC_M0MDBElg7-cnvkMJD-Bk83snZ52S06cQ2vC4bSvsf2yBYgDn-r3yBUYNtOi4noAS2Pjjh1V0UQQon9rimUuXsT_chod46mohAMaVXDZSOdRGlkn0BP8Kx3XObw1w4rIEa3dA74rswOAqwTTXdjkh8yYhL3UYuA_bJ6s2s7meAQYjP6hvPcIPQMuAHCqNrtx0tOfu8y98ds2ZpJDN) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a025ed2ec6d45af96b582d7d9a61395&_e=4vhap73vLk4fMb-Y10rIYdjPRscCQeBUVNTy_vZ9-cEE-i2qOmmYWFbZw5K6WS3QlgMcKMv6kcCg_aICHCJKBFjkEK4XJC1-6JTUJmVYOcKZ02hh1eKBnfKbWhRrIWZphihx6JO65f_xInyTaUtPFdSyiM1QaYMljYo76biKkyRzpNyY1acuXe1JB0698pPP2-ftTfnDRh-auSCw1BxAKl-tljFPCP_J91R6g-6p0f1qQKC_M0MDBElg7-cnvkMJD-Bk83snZ52S06cQ2vC4baqya1aUbVCzwWPuuYCshdtfT0Kl13naA6qBRklMIaLAh67hYTeIiWE0rspf28qOhpZc2Iv3iOSOrm83tmBFC-nax1mQUXX7ihgHNNeqqL8sLUPri1-1-CC4Xmsdn5V4Sk2rvQFt3alGXXZeUWh3NuSStm_3XTnBvu7JynoDuNBB)**

Question: Why is Colonel Mark Robertson the best Republican candidate to beat Dina Titus?
| | | |
---

---
Hello Peter,
A Facebook user recently asked an important question.....
Question: Why is Colonel Mark Robertson the best Republican candidate to beat Dina Titus? Answer: Colonel Robertson is the best candidate to win this year. Drawing inspiration from Ronald Reagan and Abraham Lincoln, who both faced initial setbacks, our campaign has learned valuable lessons that we will use to secure victory in 2024. In the previous election, Mark Robertson beat Dina Titus in Boulder City and Henderson. His overall lead was a significant 20 points among in-person voters, a testament to his appeal. Titus, on the other hand, won through ballot harvesting and mail-in ballots. It's worth noting that 46,000 registered Republicans did not vote. Titus won by a mere 7,000 votes, with just 51.6% of the vote, the lowest among all other Democrats who won congressional seats in Nevada. We have the names, addresses, and many phone numbers of the Republicans who did not vote. Hundreds of volunteers are contacting these Republicans to encourage them to vote early by any means (in person, by mail, or by dropping off their ballot). We also offer to take them or their ballots to the polls. Mark's popularity is undeniable, with thousands of followers and over 100,000 people voting for him in the previous election. His name recognition among all Republican Candidates is unparalleled. Mark's campaign covered all 14 Assembly Districts in the first congressional district, winning nearly half of them. In contrast, the only other 2024 Republican Primary candidate who ran last time, Flemming Larsen, ran in only one small assembly district and, unfortunately, lost. Larsen's campaign is currently $1,500,000 in debt. In stark contrast, Mark's campaign is debt-free and has a healthy financial reserve. Colonel Robertson's campaign is backed by a well-thought-out strategy and the necessary resources to retire Dina Titus. To delve deeper into Mark's impressive qualifications, visit www.RobertsonForCongress.com.

*************************************************************************************************

Here are eight great and simple ways to support Mark.
1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail.
2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: [Facebook](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nd5GMw6ciu45E-zZoQf2ieFKQS66fbcp-w0ZuZ9XZ7etPjkFPg5jKcZlSibetZ1BDK-qFI9pLRqLtOzfKcLJI7I3x5XPZ2aRd-onyMImtDk_llCG-w5UhrdXGNQVx-mleMuUsQjVfprWIy9L17ATHU7AfCgYNm5suaCIm7M2I9w=&c=Omogejw-mAuKISaNUEqql359iYX8p0M8cn-S8lf0_qNchLSLNbN8Kw==&ch=y8XjmRyCg8HGj6pgXVUR-7kJ5jE9nmndt3SfvgSU0pRLBaHRzwEogw==). When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button.
3. Host a Meet & Greet. This is the secret behind Mark's success. Last time, he won the Primary election without advertising - it was all word-of-mouth and grassroots-driven. It is not difficult to host a Meet & Greet. Invite some friends and neighbors over to your house or another meeting place. Mark will come to introduce himself and answer questions. You can sign up for a Meet & Greet at this link: [https://calendly.com/robertson-for-congress/meet-and-greet](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nd5GMw6ciu45E-zZoQf2ieFKQS66fbcp-w0ZuZ9XZ7etPjkFPg5jKUZ-JokCyeEIhFTv9GCiwqrupa2AEw7I9HrwngkI5m8G_qnWm7hkrAgXhoO5CqqS214TfYqRhBAxZ8_Nz328rZ_FSoEXxN-1RI3Ib6hQDgW9GeajEDHC0XGyArV-CS0y9xJRP-TUpzkK2kNcpUjvlLs=&c=Omogejw-mAuKISaNUEqql359iYX8p0M8cn-S8lf0_qNchLSLNbN8Kw==&ch=y8XjmRyCg8HGj6pgXVUR-7kJ5jE9nmndt3SfvgSU0pRLBaHRzwEogw==)
4. Install a Yard Sign. Enthusiastic volunteers will install a sign in your yard. Call or text this number and leave a message with your address: (818) 932-8050.
5. Invite Mark as a Speaker. If you belong to a group (Book Club, for example), invite Mark to drop by for a few minutes to introduce himself and answer questions. Call or text this number to check his schedule: (702) 379-5704.
6. Knock on Doors. We'll provide you with a list of registered voters in your area so you can leave some literature at their front door. If you feel comfortable, you could ring the doorbell and tell them about Mark. Call or text Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050
7. Make Phone Calls. We'll provide a list of registered voters, their phone numbers, and a simple script. At your convenience, you can call. Most calls go to voicemail, so you can leave a short message encouraging them to vote for Mark. Call Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050
8. Make a Financial Contribution. Mark is very frugal, but it still costs money to purchase signs and literature. You can donate to the campaign at this link: [https://secure.anedot.com/robertson-for-congress/2024-launch](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nd5GMw6ciu45E-zZoQf2ieFKQS66fbcp-w0ZuZ9XZ7etPjkFPg5jKQb_m3G4g69Q9LYXX0IHTETP9Fusk6OVzWWxTVm8Wv3lJLt-weZy7j3FMmr-ZdsnhPAIt90DgXfOJKpdzL7Lh1z3Y_b534G2bsC40Gjr292QjkdTZU9n10l1__wg3F5FPxwEQKLkhsZlm7gVdPsv_JM=&c=Omogejw-mAuKISaNUEqql359iYX8p0M8cn-S8lf0_qNchLSLNbN8Kw==&ch=y8XjmRyCg8HGj6pgXVUR-7kJ5jE9nmndt3SfvgSU0pRLBaHRzwEogw==)
Join Congressman Chris Stewart and Colonel Mark Robertson at an exclusive gathering for supporters on Monday, April 8th, at 6:30 p.m. at the Green Valley Multi-Gen Center, meeting Room A, 250 S. Green Valley Pkwy. Henderson, NV 89012. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called " The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of " The Second World Wars" on DVD: Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College P.S. The " The Second World Wars" DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. Freedom Nation Today PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

name: Craig Segall, Evergreen
subject: Call out EEI for funding anti-climate obstruction with YOUR money
body:
...and delaying the clean energy future we deserve
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2587808/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

I'm sure you know which utility company you pay your power bill to each month, but do you know Edison Electric Institute (EEI)—the group that lobbies on behalf of utility companies across the country—is actively attacking climate progress?

If not, you should. Because **it's currently using money from ratepayers to sue the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) over common-sense climate rules** —limits on harmful pollution from power plants—that advocates like you helped secure just months ago.

As if jacking up our bills isn't already bad enough, what dirty utilities and their lobbyists are doing behind the scenes to make us reliant on expensive fossil fuels is even worse. And it's completely out of step with the greenwashed climate commitments they make to us as rate-paying customers.

But if enough people speak up and publicly call out the bad actors who are using this corruption to pad their wallets, **we can get them to cave to public pressure and stop funding climate obstruction once and for all.** |
---
[TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2587809/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Power plants are to blame for a whopping 25 percent of our nation's climate pollution. And EPA is taking on this problem thanks to its first-ever national limits on climate pollution, which will cut nearly 2 billion tons of carbon.

By suing EPA, EEI and dirty utility companies have shown us their true faces—they're more interested in keeping business as usual to protect their ancient fossil power plants and monopolies than they are in their own climate commitments.

**We have the right to demand more from those we pay each month to power our homes.**[**That's why EEI needs to hear directly from you: We do not want our money funding climate obstruction.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2587810/87SdQ4wZ)

Thanks for all you do, |

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! The current Congressional Representative for New York 21, like all other U.S. Representatives, has a House.gov website. The taxpayers pay for it. The usual ethics rules apply.
Starting May 29, 2024, Rep. Elise Stefanik began posting fake news on her House.gov (which the taxpayers pay for) regarding the selection of Juan Merchan as the judge to preside over the Trump hush money trial.
Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..keg_xqELp1_PFuWuvJewPCN0_AtrlkBLIjNisUgwF9s?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=145163954)
"Fake news" is defined as those news stories that are false: the story itself is fabricated, with no verifiable facts, sources or quotes. (Source: [https://guides.lib.umich.edu/fakenews](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bbbece88-4da2-4b7e-8c89-111ef2731cf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
On her House.gov site (which the taxpayers pay for), Stefanik posted an article bearing the headline "Rep. Stefanik's Complaint: Selection of Acting Judge Merchan was 'not random at all', from a publication known as World Tribune. Mind you - not the Buddhist publication known as ["World Tribune](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e8460fac-ed94-4de8-bde6-b1458d602ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" that is "The Voice of Courage and Hope", filled with smiling faces of people who could be posted children for diversity, equity, and inclusion. No, this is a different ["World Tribune"](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/09d7676b-21d9-43f2-858b-9367446cec2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with the motto, "Window on the Real World". (The former is .org and latter is .com.) The World Tribune linked on Stefanik's House.gov site purports to be connected to a 501c3 known as FreePressFoundation, that publishes "Standards for the American Free Press." Legal Counsel is none other than the infamous Roy M. Cohn (1977-1986), with "Backup Paralegals", Hummer, Rude, Hussein, Nasty and Tong.
I'm really not making this stuff up.
Stefanik posted another article questioning the selection of Judge Merchan for the Trump trial on her House.gov site (which the taxpayers pay for), linked from the Washington Times, a publication founded by Sun Myung Moon in 1982. The Washington Times boasts its "founder's vision to provide a trusted counterweight to the media often identified as "mainstream" and whose "audience consists of readers outside the halls of power."
Stefanik's House.gov website (which the taxpayers pay for) includes a link to an article from the NY Post, a tabloid owned by Rupert Murdoch known for its sensational headlines.
And Stefanik's House.gov website (which the taxpayers pay for) includes a link to the paper founded in 1955 by William F. Buckley, Jr., the National Review.
In the aftermath of the trial verdict, rightfully presided over by Judge Juan Merchan, I urge you to watch what they do, but watch what you do, too.
Please - don't even click on headlines that appear to be from dubious sources. In so doing, you add to their advertising power (when pricing their ads, digital publications boast the number of clicks their headlines get). You should also know that clicking on a headline signals to other sites that you are interested in this type of news. Your so-called metadata isn't just restricted to the phenomenon of shopping for shoes online and then suddenly getting online advertisements for shoes.
Before you share an article, look at the source. On a web-based publication, you can find this information either in the "About" tab, or else by scrolling down to the bottom of the page. If you can't find that information, or if something about the images, fonts, or sensationalism doesn't pass your gut check, don't share it.
Your online persona will thank you. Your contribution to the campaign to stop the spread of fake news will be much appreciated by the rest of us.
In her book, _Attack from Within_ , Barbara McQuade describes how challenging it can be to self-monitor and not participate in the dissemination of misinformation. McQuade relates the experience of reading something, and instantly sending it to her sister. In so doing, she participated in the spread of fake news.
Misinformation and disinformation are at the heart of what threw the 2016 election. Misinformation and disinformation continue to drive the disparity in awareness in the United States today.
Between now and the November election, be vigilant. Sometimes you might want to share something you read online just to express outrage or horror. How often do we want to send something to a friend, as if to say, "Can you believe what they are saying now?" In so doing, we are boosting the algorithms and advertising power of fake news.
Ironically, former First Lady Melania Trump urged us to self-moderate online bullying and our behavior on social media in her campaign, "Be Best." I suppose the taxpayers paid for that campaign, too.
Honestly, as I said last night on "X" (the platform formerly known as Twitter), **[it ought to be scantionable to use government resources](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/daebef64-f7b3-45d2-8d2c-204bf01731b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , as Stefanik is doing on her House.gov site (which the taxpayers pay for) to direct your constituents to fake news. If the roles were reversed, you betcha (tip of the hat to another famous Republican, Sarah Palin) that Stefanik would file ethics charges against a Democrat who posted fake news to their House.gov website (which the taxpayers pay for).
In February of 2017 (shortly after Trump was sworn into office for the first term), the Washington Post adopted the motto, "Democracy Dies in Darkness." I'm writing today to encourage you to not spread the darkness. Think before you click, link, or share something you read online.
It is a sad day when the official website of an elected official is hijacked to spread fake news. I suppose the Democrats are busy serving their constituents to file an ethics charge for this mis-appropriation of taxpayer funds.
We don't have to perpetuate the misinformation and disinformation from a sitting Representative's House.gov website, but we do have to be aware of it. After all - did I mention? The taxpayers pay for it.

How often do we want to send something to a friend, as if to say, "Can you believe what they are saying now?" In so doing, we are boosting the algorithms and advertising power of fake news. Ironically, former First Lady Melania Trump urged us to self-moderate online bullying and our behavior on social media in her campaign, "Be Best." I suppose the taxpayers paid for that campaign, too. Honestly, as I said last night on "X" (the platform formerly known as Twitter), ** , as Stefanik is doing on her House.gov site (which the taxpayers pay for) to direct your constituents to fake news. If the roles were reversed, you betcha (tip of the hat to another famous Republican, Sarah Palin) that Stefanik would file ethics charges against a Democrat who posted fake news to their House.gov website (which the taxpayers pay for). In February of 2017 (shortly after Trump was sworn into office for the first term), the Washington Post adopted the motto, "Democracy Dies in Darkness." I'm writing today to encourage you to not spread the darkness. Think before you click, link, or share something you read online. It is a sad day when the official website of an elected official is hijacked to spread fake news. I suppose the Democrats are busy serving their constituents to file an ethics charge for this mis-appropriation of taxpayer funds. We don't have to perpetuate the misinformation and disinformation from a sitting Representative's House.gov website, but we do have to be aware of it. After all - did I mention? The taxpayers pay for it. Thanks for reading Paula's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: End-of-May News from the Shelby County Republican Party
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

I’m sure you have all heard about President Trump's guilty verdict in New York City.

If you haven’t given much thought to the word “tyranny” lately, it's time to start thinking about it. The pattern is unmistakable in our nation. The importance of this November cannot be overstated. Our nation is either going to go the way of the Democrat left in November, or we’re going to survive another day to fight for the nation our founders gave us.

Many of you may want to find visible ways to show your support for President Trump, so I wanted to get this out quickly and invite you to walk with the Republican Party float in three Shelby County parades that are about to happen. Bring flags or banners or signs and wear your Trump gear, and let’s let everyone know that we stand behind President Trump 100%. Here are the parade dates and locations:

Jackson Center - Sunday, June 2 at 2:00pm

Botkins - Sunday, June 9 at 1:00pm

Anna - Saturday, June 15 at 11:30am

More later on the tyranny we’ve experienced, are experiencing, and that will certainly increase unless we confront it!

Cheers...Dan Cecil
Chairman
(937) 206-2970
[cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)

body:
This request comes at an absolutely critical time for our campaign, for Arizona, and for our country. Please, let me explain:
#

Good morning, Peter.
Today is our May fundraising deadline, and I am reaching out to humbly ask if you could please make a $3 contribution to my campaign for Senate.
This request comes at an absolutely critical time for our campaign, for Arizona, and for our country. Please, let me explain:
I respected John McCain and his service in the Navy and in public life. He was a good man and Arizonans were lucky to have him.
He used to represent the Republican Party in Arizona.
Today, Kari Lake is the Republican Party in Arizona. Someone who will do or say whatever she has to if it gets her elected. Who attacks our democracy at every turn and lies, spins conspiracies, and is Trump’s loudest, proudest advocate.
Now, if you’re with me and you’re ready to stop Kari Lake before she gains any more power and influence, please:
[**Make that $3 contribution and help me win this race before our deadline hits at midnight tonight.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may24.hD4hyN&refcode=em240531-1-160&t=1&akid=2407%2E734936%2EMu0b_w)

This race is a head-to-head between Kari Lake and me, with control of the U.S. Senate on the line. This race could go either way. And the toughest part for us is that Arizona is one of the most expensive states in the country to campaign in.
Whether we win or not is going to depend on whether we raise the resources we need to do it.
I know that Kari is raising money hand over fist right now, and she’s pouring that back into attack ads — $10 million worth are reserved already. She’ll use every dollar to tear me apart. If we can’t fight back, she could get the edge on us.
She could win. Really.
That’s why I’m writing to you. I need your help. Almost all of our donations come in response to emails like this one. There’s just no other way for our campaign to raise the money we need to win.
So, here is the part where I ask you, very humbly:

name: Mark Kelly
subject: We’ll fight like hell
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Friend: I’m writing to ask you for $5.
That’s right: just $5.
$5 because we’re preparing for some of the closest elections in the country in Arizona.
$5 because defeating Kari Lake in Arizona could very well determine whether or not we hold the Senate. Picking up some seats in Arizona could determine whether or not we take back the House. And defeating Trump in Arizona is almost certain to decide who wins the White House.
$5 because Kari Lake lost by just 17,000 votes in her campaign for Governor in 2022. Trump lost by just 10,000 votes here in 2020.
Don’t make the mistake of thinking that Arizona is a blue state just because we won the last few elections here. We had to fight like hell to do it, and we will again.
Arizona is ground zero for the MAGA-Right and all their conspiracies and election denial. Arizona is the frontline.
I’m going to be working all year long to make sure pro-democracy candidates win in Arizona and defeat Kari Lake and the other MAGA Republicans.
I need your help to do it.
