Despite virtually every member of Congress having campaigned on making life-saving drugs more accessible, politicians who take millions of dollars from Big Pharma are still telling us we have to accept a world where people die because they have to ration their medicine.
Then we have out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley, who have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own them — and they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more liars or frauds like Josh Hawley in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. **[And it’s why I'm asking you to add a donation of whatever you can toward our people-powered campaign before our next major end-of-month deadline at midnight tonight. Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. ---
| | 1\. The Most Expensive Race In Washington History?
---
| | The MAGA movement, which has significantly altered the Republican National Committee (RNC) and the U.S. House of Representatives, is now making waves in Washington and Oregon. What implications does this hold for the GOP and for those who value democratic principles?In a recent [blog](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=ngyZujSkMlNviyaAu32utbVJK9MGdg1s97yLdKAkOhE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvdGhlLXdhc2hpbmd0b24tc3RhdGUtZ29wLWhhcy1kZWNsYXJlZC13YXItb24tZGVtb2NyYWN5IiwiciI6ImZhNGU3NjM4LTc0NDEtNDM2Yy04MjgyLWU5ZjhjOWEwNzYyMyIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9), we discussed the Washington State GOP's shift towards MAGA, abandoning traditional Republican values. The Washington GOP has adopted an aggressive stance that seems to undermine constitutional democracy. A similar scenario is unfolding in Oregon, where members of an [anti-government group founded by far-right militia figure Ammon Bundy](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=uFHiMLHABrl4L_40FlOe1-7ce0nEaCjPijV2RcMH2Cs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlZ3VhcmRpYW4uY29tL3VzLW5ld3MvYXJ0aWNsZS8yMDI0L21heS8yNC9wZW9wbGUtcmlnaHRzLW5ldHdvcmstb3JlZ29uLWVsZWN0aW9ucyIsInIiOiJmYTRlNzYzOC03NDQxLTQzNmMtODI4Mi1lOWY4YzlhMDc2MjMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) are running for Precinct Committee Officers (PCOs). Although PCO is an entry-level position, its importance cannot be overstated. PCOs organize and mobilize voters, significantly impacting campaigns and candidate success. They also vote for party leadership at local and state levels, wielding considerable influence. Surprisingly, Republicans have not attempted to infiltrate the Democratic Party by running for Democratic PCO positions, despite the ethical and legal gray areas. In Washington, the GOP and local organizations have embraced MAGA candidates, ignoring traditional Republican frontrunners. Notably, they have endorsed Semi Bird over Dave Reichert and Jerrod Sessler over Dan Newhouse or Tiffany Smiley, who have access to significant financial support. Local chambers of commerce, like the Greater Yakima Chamber of Commerce, have shown biased support for MAGA candidates, and similar actions are expected from other local organizations. For non-MAGA voters, three critical races in Congressional Districts 3, 4, and 5 are upcoming. In District 3, Maria Perez faces Joe Kent and Leslie Lewallen. With solid financial backing and a stable base, Perez is well-positioned to succeed. District 4 promises to be the most contentious and one of the most expensive races in Washington State history. Incumbent Dan Newhouse, who previously raised seven million dollars effortlessly, will likely have substantial financial backing. Tiffany Smiley, who raised twenty million in her Senate run, is expected to gather significant funds again. Meanwhile, like Loren Culp before him, Jerrod Sessler faces financial struggles even with Trump’s and the Washington State GOP endorsements. Sessler is starting about four hundred thousand dollars in debt. With around twenty-three million Republican dollars in play, progressives and moderates face a tough battle. A MAGA candidate victory could drive more Democrats to support Newhouse, potentially reducing the Democratic vote from 32-34% to 28-30%, but still enough for a Democrat to advance past the primary. In District 5, the race presents a significant opportunity following Cathy McMorris Rodgers' exit as outlined in a recent [blog post](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=e-DqIxqU3DIgUuLTxDs18RwqBWczc731WoQNfYyrScA.). While there are uncertainties regarding the candidates' ability to engage the media, raise funds, and build strong campaigns, there is a clear path to victory. Close monitoring of [FEC ](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=DGjJDt5-h_f__7sp3ZknZe0KMBo-xFv-LZnBpsdvwN8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi8iLCJyIjoiZmE0ZTc2MzgtNzQ0MS00MzZjLTgyODItZTlmOGM5YTA3NjIzIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)filings will reveal who is putting in the necessary work. In summary, the MAGA influence in Washington and Oregon is reshaping the GOP and presenting new challenges for democratic values. The upcoming races in Congressional Districts 3, 4, and 5 will be pivotal in determining the future political landscape.

| | 2\. Rural Americans United Targets Untapped Voter Pool
---
| | Over the course of the last several weeks we have made a clear argument for our newly registered campaign: [May 1](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=MD6P0ChSDT-Zn9258K7E2RmypwImebheYAfkC9j_J7o.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3Qvdm9pY2VzLXVuaGVhcmQtZW1wb3dlcmluZy1jaGFuZ2Utd2l0aC1ydXJhbC1hbWVyaWNhbnMtdW5pdGVkIiwiciI6IjNhNWE3YzhiLTIzNjgtNDQ3Ny1hMWRjLTRmY2ExM2NhYTA4MiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9), [May 8](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=IrUPMz--46pJslBFlKJN3hLq6e2asEhY6xMIBq2rp5A.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvdGhlLXdhc2hpbmd0b24tc3RhdGUtZ29wLWhhcy1kZWNsYXJlZC13YXItb24tZGVtb2NyYWN5IiwiciI6IjNhNWE3YzhiLTIzNjgtNDQ3Ny1hMWRjLTRmY2ExM2NhYTA4MiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) and [May 20](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47O-Bt0b5/c?w=AXZrleMcnFhR9RRLon61aEVDIUsaAVsbP4XETrAes4M.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvZGVtb2NyYXRzLWN1cmUtbWFnYS1jYW5jZXItc3VubGlnaHQiLCJyIjoiM2E1YTdjOGItMjM2OC00NDc3LWExZGMtNGZjYTEzY2FhMDgyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0). We have identified three compelling reasons why engaging this group is crucial for both immediate election success and a long-term strategy to bring sensible politics back to Central and Eastern Washington. Firstly, we need their votes. The Democratic strategy is strong: mobilize core Democrats, canvass known Democrats, and get out the vote (GOTV) from intermittent Democratic voters. This effort should yield a 32% Democratic turnout. However, to win, we need 50% plus one vote, and 32% simply isn’t enough. Secondly, we must broaden our outreach to potential voters. The current strategy employed by Democrats and most campaign consultants targets voters with known voting histories. This approach is reinforced by data sources like VoteBuilder, which identifies target audiences based on several factors, primarily political leanings and likelihood to vote a particular way. Newly registered voters, lacking a voting record, are often overlooked. The number of newly registered voters is significant—certainly enough to tip the scales in a local election. Thirdly, the newly registered voting population is largely comprised of three marginalized groups: youth, Latinx, and Indigenous people. Voting data suggests that youth and Latinx voters are being swayed by the far-right, while Indigenous voters are neglected. These groups demand our attention and support. Ignoring them is not just a strategic error—it is a moral failing. Rural Americans United is taking action across the seventeen counties that make up Central and Eastern Washington. We recognize the importance of partnering with communities and organizations that serve these marginalized groups. We are committed to supporting these efforts in every possible way, including covering all costs and logistical activities. This is a pivotal moment. Mobilizing newly registered voters is not just a strategy—it’s a necessity. By reaching out and engaging these overlooked populations, we can secure the votes needed for victory and ensure that the voices of all community members are heard. Let's harness this opportunity to make a real difference and bring sensible politics back to our region. The time to act is now.

Notably, they have endorsed Semi Bird over Dave Reichert and Jerrod Sessler over Dan Newhouse or Tiffany Smiley, who have access to significant financial support. Local chambers of commerce, like the Greater Yakima Chamber of Commerce, have shown biased support for MAGA candidates, and similar actions are expected from other local organizations. For non-MAGA voters, three critical races in Congressional Districts 3, 4, and 5 are upcoming. In District 3, Maria Perez faces Joe Kent and Leslie Lewallen. With solid financial backing and a stable base, Perez is well-positioned to succeed. District 4 promises to be the most contentious and one of the most expensive races in Washington State history. Incumbent Dan Newhouse, who previously raised seven million dollars effortlessly, will likely have substantial financial backing. Tiffany Smiley, who raised twenty million in her Senate run, is expected to gather significant funds again. Meanwhile, like Loren Culp before him, Jerrod Sessler faces financial struggles even with Trump’s and the Washington State GOP endorsements. Sessler is starting about four hundred thousand dollars in debt. With around twenty-three million Republican dollars in play, progressives and moderates face a tough battle. A MAGA candidate victory could drive more Democrats to support Newhouse, potentially reducing the Democratic vote from 32-34% to 28-30%, but still enough for a Democrat to advance past the primary. In District 5, the race presents a significant opportunity following Cathy McMorris Rodgers' exit as outlined in a recent . While there are uncertainties regarding the candidates' ability to engage the media, raise funds, and build strong campaigns, there is a clear path to victory. Close monitoring of will reveal who is putting in the necessary work. In summary, the MAGA influence in Washington and Oregon is reshaping the GOP and presenting new challenges for democratic values. The upcoming races in Congressional Districts 3, 4, and 5 will be pivotal in determining the future political landscape. | | | | | 2\. Rural Americans United Targets Untapped Voter Pool | | Over the course of the last several weeks we have made a clear argument for our newly registered campaign: , and . We have identified three compelling reasons why engaging this group is crucial for both immediate election success and a long-term strategy to bring sensible politics back to Central and Eastern Washington. Firstly, we need their votes. The Democratic strategy is strong: mobilize core Democrats, canvass known Democrats, and get out the vote (GOTV) from intermittent Democratic voters. This effort should yield a 32% Democratic turnout. However, to win, we need 50% plus one vote, and 32% simply isn’t enough. Secondly, we must broaden our outreach to potential voters. The current strategy employed by Democrats and most campaign consultants targets voters with known voting histories. This approach is reinforced by data sources like VoteBuilder, which identifies target audiences based on several factors, primarily political leanings and likelihood to vote a particular way. Newly registered voters, lacking a voting record, are often overlooked. The number of newly registered voters is significant—certainly enough to tip the scales in a local election. Thirdly, the newly registered voting population is largely comprised of three marginalized groups: youth, Latinx, and Indigenous people. Voting data suggests that youth and Latinx voters are being swayed by the far-right, while Indigenous voters are neglected. These groups demand our attention and support. Ignoring them is not just a strategic error—it is a moral failing. Rural Americans United is taking action across the seventeen counties that make up Central and Eastern Washington. We recognize the importance of partnering with communities and organizations that serve these marginalized groups. We are committed to supporting these efforts in every possible way, including covering all costs and logistical activities. This is a pivotal moment. Mobilizing newly registered voters is not just a strategy—it’s a necessity. By reaching out and engaging these overlooked populations, we can secure the votes needed for victory and ensure that the voices of all community members are heard. Let's harness this opportunity to make a real difference and bring sensible politics back to our region. The time to act is now. | | | | | 3\. Seventy-Six Gifts! And Over One Hundred Thank You Cards | | In June, we will be shipping out Seventy-Six gifts to our incredible supporters. These gifts represent donors who have committed to recurring donations for six months or made equivalent one-time contributions. And this is just the beginning! Our list of monthly recurring donors is growing daily, providing the critical resources we need to mobilize voters, especially within our marginalized communities: youth, Latinx, and Indigenous populations. | | | | Your generous support is the backbone of our efforts. Every donation, whether large or small, empowers us to reach out, engage, and ensure that every voice is heard in Central and Eastern Washington. We are on a mission to bring sensible politics back to our region, and we can't do it without you. | | | | | 4\. Granny Caravan: Unity Road Tour | | | | We introduced you to the fabulous octogenarians Roz Luther and Shirley Grossman in our April 18th . Since then, they've made exciting plans and rebranded as the Granny Caravan: Unity Road Tour. With their big purple hats and boundless energy, they'll kick off the tour on June 12th, visiting fifteen towns across Eastern Washington.This tour promises to be a blast, spreading a powerful message of unity, healing, and ensuring that everyone feels heard and respected. Besides helping with voter registration, these dynamic Grannies will chat with local organizations and individuals to understand their interests and concerns, bringing these insights back to the candidates. This kind of personalized interaction is a rare and refreshing change from the usual. | | | | Watch our newsletters and social media as we take you along on the Granny Caravan. | | | | | 5\. body:
You've had my back through toughest fights in Washington
| | |
---
Friend, I want to personally thank you for always standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85990662/476492831/-1789327584?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5087-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODI1NjViMy01NDFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fd5THh6UMaCtMcdVLPsN8TaSAHPUIcEATmKU9Ww1LCw=)
Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 14 years of advocacy, late nights and whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**
But here's the bad news: Republicans are emboldened after their historic victories in New York in 2022. **Now, they're laying the groundwork for an even bigger red wave in 2024 — and they're directly targeting my seat.** I refuse to accept a single cent from corporate PACs, so I'm relying on grassroots donors like you to compete with their right-wing megadonors.
**[_Please, friend, you've stood by me so many times before, and I'm counting on you to have my back again. Will you chip in before my end-of-month deadline at midnight tonight to join me in this fight for progress and defend our Senate majority? Gen Z must meet their moment in time now by passing the strongest, most effective domestic gun control policies known to man.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240531-1&t=1&akid=747%2E587540%2EEU1ns-)
Peter,
People often believe that Gen Z and Baby Boomers are stark opposites of each other. But that’s a total myth.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240531?refcode=em20240531-1&amount=5&refcode2=747_587540_EU1ns-&akid=747%2E587540%2EEU1ns-)
Boomers and Gen Z actually have quite a bunch in common when it comes to gun control.
**Both generations ducked under the same tables for bomb/safety drills.** The only difference now is that Gen Z also practices for active shooter and general lockdown drills as well.
**Both generations advocated for arms reduction policies.** The generation of the Baby Boomers passed some of the largest arms reduction treaties in human history. Now, Gen Z will do the same thing passing domestic gun control bills to go one step further in protecting American lives at home.
**Both generations had to cope with gun violence.** Baby Boomers had to cope with the aftermath of 2 successful assassinations that happened as they grew up: John F. Kennedy and Martin Luther King Jr. Similarly, Gen Z found themselves in front of the muzzle of a gun at their schools over 340 times last year.
Just like the Baby Boomers passed arms reduction policies and took decisive actions to protect their lives, Gen Z must meet their moment in time now by passing the strongest, most effective domestic gun control policies known to man. That is why Leaders We Deserve is so committed to electing young leaders who understand the need to bring positive change back to their communities.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE DATE: May 31, 2024 CONTACT: Mike Lynch 970-214-4272
Rep. Lynch Calls Out Lies and Absurdity of CD4 Candidates Crowded debate field has one clear voice of reason- Mike Lynch

---
DENVER-- Colorado State Representative Mike Lynch, one of six republicans running for Colorado's Fourth Congressional District (CD4), ripped into Lauren Boebert for her repeated lies and failed record in Washington during a debate held by 9News on May 30, 2024.
The former House Minority leader referenced a [non-partisan congressional scorecard](https://tdohcvgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R96CZ2GMQNXHw9WSBGJDihUWtDEB7ZhghLVbpfyBheKH3-mkNJkq1mJBI9EQUVuRMY-X2U3P5o8rqy0IqZI_a9jVoCFNzRgHtz1bZN9VVlB6zBqIYmqN0Lz2nOOdabtMPN4sDbylC9n_RPJq1xysjxFZBPd2no2MsD6XXXZvzp0TjgGm1eNnbE2sqFSEIVjvGBUlLrTRVG-YNjJ9ND8Z0G4EUDA8K0RyShZaqV7TULc=&c=4vOcM9eoW5DFdZsnr_hNzCE5f0W50iddjpyzWHsDJTlV3f8RpWDP_w==&ch=npOIA7j0JYjfy9pTU6ut7s0iI41WWGnYrZ_BNXDfRKCNQWYswok7-A==) that shows Boebert as one of the least effective members in her first session. While the results are not out for the current session, debate moderator Kyle Clark of 9News noted the current session is expected to be one of the least productive in recent history, despite the many daunting issues facing millions of American families and businesses.
"The only reason Boebert is in this race is due to her abysmal favorability rating among her constituents and yet she continues to tell bold-faced lies to cover her sorry excuse for being ineffective." said Lynch. "Unlike her and the other candidates, I have never backed down from delivering results for my constituents. With fentanyl overdoses plaguing our communities, out-of-control inflation and total dysfunction in Washington, we need to send someone who will actually vote on bills and do the job the voters expect them to do."
Lynch has had more than 50 of his bills become Colorado state law in the same time that Boebert has been in office. Boebert voted against her one bill that became law when it came to the House floor.
Other absurd remarks from the candidates included Peter Yu believing we are in an ice age and Deborah Flora, who has never held elected office, being clueless as to the immigration crisis and its impacts on CD4.
Lynch closed the debate touting his background as a husband, father, veteran and small business owner and drew attention to the other candidates' lies about their inaccurate legislative records and the lack of confidence of the other candidates who have never held elected office.
The primary will be held on June 25 and mail ballots will arrive beginning next week. Registered republicans and unaffiliated voters are eligible to vote in the upcoming republican primary. To learn more about Mike Lynch's qualifications and background, visit [LynchforColorado.com ](https://tdohcvgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R96CZ2GMQNXHw9WSBGJDihUWtDEB7ZhghLVbpfyBheKH3-mkNJkq1mJBI9EQUVuR3bpFD9qTDrUpz2JBR2Ze-xHudV_zVWLmIt6rDIu2nUthL0iQdN7310UDnW42YYYluJPZLXLCuDlJn1zIJ14Pw17s_F-le7AP&c=4vOcM9eoW5DFdZsnr_hNzCE5f0W50iddjpyzWHsDJTlV3f8RpWDP_w==&ch=npOIA7j0JYjfy9pTU6ut7s0iI41WWGnYrZ_BNXDfRKCNQWYswok7-A==)

### About Mike Lynch:
### Mike Lynch is a proven common sense conservative and candidate for Colorado Congressional District 4. He was elected to the Colorado House of Representatives in 2020. Mike is a native Coloradan, West Point graduate, veteran small business owner, and has been married to his wife Alex for 23 years. They are the parents of two recent high school graduates, one at Arizona State University and the other at West Point. He believes in restoring trust in government and prioritizing the needs of middle-class families and taxpayers through common-sense leadership.

clean_body: Crowded debate field has one clear voice of reason— Mike Lynch | | | | == | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE DATE: May 31, 2024 CONTACT: Mike Lynch 970-214-4272 Rep. Lynch Calls Out Lies and Absurdity of CD4 Candidates Crowded debate field has one clear voice of reason- Mike Lynch DENVER-- Colorado State Representative Mike Lynch, one of six republicans running for Colorado's Fourth Congressional District (CD4), ripped into Lauren Boebert for her repeated lies and failed record in Washington during a debate held by 9News on May 30, 2024. The former House Minority leader referenced a == that shows Boebert as one of the least effective members in her first session. While the results are not out for the current session, debate moderator Kyle Clark of 9News noted the current session is expected to be one of the least productive in recent history, despite the many daunting issues facing millions of American families and businesses. "The only reason Boebert is in this race is due to her abysmal favorability rating among her constituents and yet she continues to tell bold-faced lies to cover her sorry excuse for being ineffective." said Lynch. "Unlike her and the other candidates, I have never backed down from delivering results for my constituents. With fentanyl overdoses plaguing our communities, out-of-control inflation and total dysfunction in Washington, we need to send someone who will actually vote on bills and do the job the voters expect them to do." Lynch has had more than 50 of his bills become Colorado state law in the same time that Boebert has been in office. Boebert voted against her one bill that became law when it came to the House floor. Other absurd remarks from the candidates included Peter Yu believing we are in an ice age and Deborah Flora, who has never held elected office, being clueless as to the immigration crisis and its impacts on CD4. Lynch closed the debate touting his background as a husband, father, veteran and small business owner and drew attention to the other candidates' lies about their inaccurate legislative records and the lack of confidence of the other candidates who have never held elected office. The primary will be held on June 25 and mail ballots will arrive beginning next week. Registered republicans and unaffiliated voters are eligible to vote in the upcoming republican primary. To learn more about Mike Lynch's qualifications and background, visit == About Mike Lynch: Mike Lynch is a proven common sense conservative and candidate for Colorado Congressional District 4. They are the parents of two recent high school graduates, one at Arizona State University and the other at West Point. | BREAKING NEWS: A jury of twelve ordinary citizens found Donald Trump GUILTY on all 34 counts in the People of the State of New York v. Trump case of falsifying business records to cover up campaign finance violations during the 2016 presidential election. It is the first conviction of a former U.S. president in history. This is an important affirmation of the rule of law. No one individual, no matter how powerful or rich, is above the law. Not even a former President of the United States. Anything less is not democracy. Trump’s felony convictions will not bar him from running for President, and we will still need to defeat him in November. And as we saw outside the courthouse immediately after the verdict, he will be even more aggressive in attacking the democratic guardrails protecting our institutions. [So this is no time to let up in our efforts to ensure a Democratic majority in the House and Senate. | | | Peter, A Manhattan jury found Trump guilty on all 34 felony counts of falsifying business records to cover up campaign finance violations during the 2016 election. Twelve ordinary American citizens decided the legal fate of Donald Trump. Proving that nobody – not even a former President of the United States or (pretend) billionaire – is above the law. And despite Trump’s efforts to distract, delay, and deny – justice arrived for Donald Trump all the same. And by a jury of his peers. My takeaway: Our system of justice worked. Our rule of law withstood the immense pressure Trump brought to bear. Notwithstanding the enormous stresses on our democracy, the system is holding. And accountability matters. [Winning the presidency may now be the only thing remaining between Trump and avoiding prison time — either in this prosecution or three others — and he has shown he will tear down the entire system of American democracy to protect himself and return to power. WE MUST NOT LET HIM. Thousands of Democrats are sending in contributions to hold Trump accountable at the ballot box. Join them and split a contribution of $10 to my campaign and Blue Amp Action today before tonight’s May fundraising deadline.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T038042c4-ec2a-4959-a3f1-bced277ac553/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Make no mistake, this verdict will only increase Donald Trump’s attempts to discredit the justice system and tear down our democracy. His enablers in Congress will do the same. We need to call those efforts out for exactly what they are: A blind attempt to protect a now-convicted felon, and deeply immoral human being, in the headlong pursuit of power. Because justice prevailed. Justice. And it’s up to each of us to make sure the justice system continues to hold him accountable. In federal cases in Washington, D.C. and Florida and the state case in Georgia. And in November, we MUST defeat Donald Trump at the ballot box. That will be the ultimate accountability and affirmation of our democracy. Thanks for standing up for the rule of law and our cherished legacy. – Adam

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)
Hey team, it's Ilhan.
I'm emailing this morning to ask you to **[make a contribution to my campaign before our end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240531-1-t1&t=2&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)** And I'm hoping that before I ask, you'll give me a chance to explain why this request is so important.
Here's the truth:
Serving Minnesota's 5th district as a member of Congress and going to work fighting for working people every day is truly one of the joys of my life. It's a privilege and an honor that I have never taken for granted.
But if I had to answer what the _worst_ part of this job is, it is without a doubt, the obscene amount of money it takes to run a successful campaign.
That's because rather than taking checks from corporate PACs or industry lobbyists like many of my colleagues, I believe in people power. I believe that so long as we're all in this together, lots and lots of people chipping in what they can is more powerful than anything our opponents can throw at us.
**_That belief is what our entire campaign is about_ — building a grassroots movement of people all across the country and standing in solidarity to fight for the kind of future we know we all deserve.**
It's about fighting for a future where we combat the climate crisis and create a healthy and sustainable planet instead of boosting bonuses for fossil fuel CEOs.
It's about fighting for a future where Americans can see a doctor and get the medical treatment they need without being driven into bankruptcy and financial ruin.
It's about fighting for a future where working people can build power and exercise their right to organize in a time of record-breaking corporate profits.
It's about fighting for a future where our taxpayer dollars go towards promoting peace and justice around the world rather than funding endless wars and apartheid.
It's about showing the wealthy and powerful that our progressive movement is strong, that we're not going anywhere, and that we're going to fight back against their attacks every step of the way.
**It's about all this and so much more — which is why our opponents are working so hard to defeat us.** Right-wing super PACs and their donors are already targeting progressives nationwide, and the reality is that it's going to take an incredible amount of grassroots support to continue our fight.
So here's the part where I ask:
**[Please. If you can, will you make your first contribution — of $3 or any amount — to our re-election campaign before tonight's deadline? This campaign is funded by lots of people giving small amounts at a time, so every dollar makes a difference.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240531-1-t1&t=3&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)**
Tonight's deadline marks 73 days out from our primary in August. It's coming up faster than you might think. And it's the resources we raise and the investments we make right now that'll make all the difference.
That's why your support today is so important. Thank you for reading, and thank you in advance for chipping in if you can.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may24.KcBh3H&refcode=em240531-1-t1&t=4&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)**

PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can **[unsubscribe here](https://act.ilhanomar.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?source=em-footer&t=5&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)**. You can also **[sign up to receive fewer emails](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=6&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)**.
Submit this form to [**update your contact information**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/update-contact-info/source=em-footer?t=7&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)
Ilhan is counting on our people-powered grassroots movement to fund this campaign. If you can, stand with us by **[making a contribution today](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/io-em-footer/?refcode=em-footer&t=8&refcode2=1177_791427_c9Jxqj&akid=1177%2E791427%2Ec9Jxqj)**.
Ilhan for Congress

Washington D.C., 20033

# It Takes Strategy to Change Rural America
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndlbwinningruralamerica?refcode=gopfailure)
---
A robust rural strategy goes beyond political divides and offers tangible solutions to issues like **healthcare, education, infrastructure, and economic development.** It's no secret that many have felt unheard and overlooked. **Progressives can change that:** We can present a compelling vision for the future rural America—one that showcases our commitment to working together and finding common ground to solve the problems we face in all 50 states. **Rural America is the backbone of this country, and** **we need to start treating it as such.** Our campaign aims to bring people together, transcending political affiliations and building a stronger, more resilient nation. We believe that a diverse rural strategy is not only a political necessity but a moral imperative. Together, we can foster a sense of unity and ensure that every American, regardless of where they live, has the opportunity to thrive. I invite you to join our movement, share your insights, and help us shape a vision for America that leaves no one behind. Together, we can build a future that works for everyone. Ted Cruz has proven time and again to be the single most divisive politician in Washington. From leading the charge on the 2012 government shutdown to ushering in an era of extreme hyper-partisanship and pitting Americans against each other with dangerous, extremist rhetoric. _**Ted isn't just Texans' problem – he's ALL AMERICANS’ problem.**_

Ted Cruz's refusal to commit to accepting election results is exactly the kind of rhetoric that led to January 6, and another six years of him in the Senate is a danger our democracy simply can’t afford.

As a former voting rights lawyer, Colin knows firsthand how critical it is that we all remain committed to protecting our democracy and ensuring that something like January 6 never happens again. Texans deserve a leader who respects our democracy – and Colin will unequivocally accept the results of this election.

[If you agree that Ted Cruz's extreme, anti-democracy rhetoric needs to go, please chip in now to Colin and The Collective PAC to help us defeat him. ](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqskv9NQB2VWDB7dxl6GOAMoYYmj9rl_bBBrM7o0MIN97pdbgemwb6Y9gPsdvt-kZriJQ9Vjv55PKrsY5IXOMaKzWarj34XViU1zxmnrNtxZdkG1p2NskKseZlw2783AU4ElQTUBB_XdqMOAqbuk8Wlt3CBeq6fNO34FGqSofkxGKDA5SHwymrSqP8yeUGnBDmqBiI7_2qAHnuKLR4RGxCK9kdYHWwBcq1XPKAPUxI2Ps-AyKUmwgGLTQejahCTgiFAdbV8kLsgwJg090J3HMS-jXxbNrwZ9nYEGFvEWpnhCp1J1vTmsFzq1pjCx84fzDTT1S7uTVl33ntA_qzxc6dJXqs9yMA1LmR4GSf-5IxB4qDu-28_KzjfiMu6iXGgMBsuwZn3q4LLF_ZVHnqutV32h/46t/K5HyT-0ASSePqBNouvhkSw/h5/h001.ti-qKzBG2kq5D5lxZ3dp6l5BzGFzo4wSQ2rm0gnQn0w)

Fox News has been planting seeds to claim the trial was politically motivated since the beginning. **For example, in the early days of the trial, Fox News guests and personalities baselessly claimed at least 89 times that the jury selection process was rigged against President Trump. **
When the guilty verdict came in, things got downright dark:
* Primetime host Jesse Waters talked about his anger about the verdict, promising to “vanquish the evil forces that are destroying this republic.”
* Personality Jeanine Pirro suggested that Americans could react violently to the verdict because we are “fighters” and “revolution is in our DNA.”
* Fox News host Greg Gutfeld called the trial and the verdict a “conscious collusion of allies that came together with a private strategy to eliminate a common, shared adversary.”
* Laura Ingraham called on viewers to “turn this dark day into a time to recommit yourself to saving America from these vindictive, far-left tyrants.”

We could go on and on, but you get the point: **Fox News is doing everything it can to prop up Trump, including turning its viewers against our judicial system by using incendiary rhetoric and baseless smears. **
So Fox News is being Fox News, so what?
**First,** we are a nation of laws, not of men. By smearing our judicial system as political and corrupt, Fox News is laying the groundwork for the authoritarian presidency that Trump is promising in his second term.
**Second,** Fox’s lies have a way of becoming the unimpeachable truth for millions of Americans. Thanks to Fox News and Trump, more than half of Republican voters now believe Democrats stole the 2020 election, even though there is zero evidence to support this claim.
**Third,** and most alarmingly, we’ve already seen political violence as a direct consequence of Fox’s pro-Trump rage-baiting and conspiracies. There would be no January 6th, 2021, without Fox News. They spread the lies that directly led to the assault on our Capitol.
So that’s the bad news – the good news is that COURIER is doing something to fight back. Right now, our ten battleground state newsrooms are working around the clock to correct right-wing misinformation from Fox News.
We post our trustworthy local news coverage in the same social media feeds and email inboxes where people are most likely to encounter Fox News and Donald Trump’s lies.

During a routine anatomy scan at 19 weeks pregnant, Allie learned that the baby she was expecting, Miley Rose, was not going to make it.

Doctors warned that **continuing the pregnancy would endanger her life.** However, abortion is banned in Tennessee – forcing Allie to leave the state to seek life-saving care:

_“With a risk of sepsis, blood clots, or more, I underwent an emergency abortion. I did this alone: in a city I had never been to before, without my family or my husband there by my side,”_ Allie said.

After this horrible, tragic experience, Allie began advocating for **“Miley’s Law,”** which would add an exception for fetal anomalies to the state abortion ban.

However, her legislator, Rep. Jeff Burkhart, did not have any empathy for her experience, stating, **if his own daughter had been in Phillips’s position, he’d have wanted her to continue the pregnancy... he also said he didn’t realize abortions could happen in a second pregnancy (???).**

| | **At Movement Labs, we want to be sure that we get every single eligible voter informed, connected, and ready to participate by Election Day.** Because the sad truth is that voting rights are not equal across the board in this country. Far too often these days, right-wing election officials are skirting rules, especially in minority communities, by switching up, reducing, or closing polling places. What happened in New York City yesterday will go down as one of the most shameful days in the history of the United States of America.
A leftist prosecutor teamed up with the top guy at Biden's DOJ, invented a crime out of thin air, went to a leftist judge in one of America's most liberal jurisdictions, and worked to put the Republican nominee for president in jail.
It's a travesty of the highest order.
What was once the fairest justice system in the world has been destroyed by a desire among Democrats to put their political opponent behind bars because the American people might have the gall to elect him president again.
The State Freedom Caucus Network stands with President Trump, looks forward to these bogus charges being thrown out on appeal, and seeing him back in the White House this January.

body:
The good news is that Jill has a plan for that

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=patrick_childcare_email_5_31&n=1)
---
Peter,****
---
It’s expensive to be a parent even before you factor in the cost of Joe Biden’s economic policies. The economic policies that are helping set stock market records come at a high price.

A price that is passed onto American working and middle class families of all shapes and sizes.

It looks like never-ending inflation at the grocery store. It shows up as increases in monthly childcare costs. It feels a long heavy shadow on working class families as child poverty rates double.

**_The American people aren’t just feeling down about this economy, this economy is weighing them down._**

According to the latest Cost of Care [report](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=xKCEjU2nIBScQnIIS33hjIsmWgro8cOSyuXEXKnw4W_QvOZvb8YantZIukfRTrgh7FNXpxI7rlkMiJBTBNUdhgvcX_MH6G7s5bkeVjEoQbJTs-KMYFd__GPD8kvFmfH_3U3t0EZ-wGYsDOUSIOneFeWB3nmaznpoXBzkQSDLbm_oDlppo8_CAiIxhGsfUU4g9XJGXEsZwqfLTK-5qkUCsw2U90HhRzGW8KJZItg3g2A&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=patrick_childcare_email_5_31&n=2) (“Care. 2024”) the average weekly daycare cost is $321 - up 13% from the 2022 average of $284. If you do the math, that’s **$16,692 dollars a year.**

This is not sustainable and even Care’s CEO knows it:_“A healthy economy depends upon the ability for people to save and spend, but given the crushing weight of child care those pillars are crumbling.”_ \- Brad Wilson

The good news is that Jill has a plan for that.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=patrick_childcare_email_5_31&n=3)
---
**As President, Jill will use her mandate from you, the American people, to guarantee free childcare for all.**

A common sense policy that would protect our children while saving parents their paychecks and make it easier to keep their jobs.

Jill’s plan to guarantee free childcare even supports businesses who lose _“$1,640 on average for each working parent due to lost revenue and hiring costs because of insufficient child care”_ as of a 2023 Ready Nation [report](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=JN_AhySoYokSmOyXAQ5bIQBeWIioGfxUGq1zonw0YpD45cf2Ap-Xz_6OlGATtqnMPz2aQAqzRSF98ou_xfw3eX1vMYJV8ngW3VUNkZBh6w6WfmH2MQWkP3oAiRXuFffDfzn74M4Z4J_Mu0LlxCFFaf_sZpDAjsQYLEdaShTlmmsQoAQ7B8Cn2kwyZ8xfIFGD3zBOrLI3XY4T7KzMTutkgWP6Z6Qc19Fl0qk6dBEuYHKOSE7gwuis7Xpl-OHQKoUxIZdxaWeYsCWttEER5ZcwZ9VrY8wXWF77ZxBVooIqt0Iz78SaxW7JZAfKfNfm07B1UdduhQTc5VwmrG1QU0rmqu9LdYySo0EtpWAWUCWAtt8&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=patrick_childcare_email_5_31&n=4).

When it comes time to vote, we already know that Donald Trump _wouldn’t_ guarantee free childcare and Joe Biden _can’t_ guarantee free childcare.

Jill **will** guarantee free childcare saving families thousands every year, but she needs your ongoing support to challenge empire to get on the ballot across the nation now and win in November.
**
Peter, will you contribute what you can today to help make Jill’s plan become a reality?**

The American people aren’t just feeling down about this economy, this economy is weighing them down. According to the latest Cost of Care (“Care. 2024”) the average weekly daycare cost is $321 - up 13% from the 2022 average of $284. If you do the math, that’s $16,692 dollars a year. This is not sustainable and even Care’s CEO knows it:“A healthy economy depends upon the ability for people to save and spend, but given the crushing weight of child care those pillars are crumbling.” \- Brad Wilson The good news is that Jill has a plan for that. As President, Jill will use her mandate from you, the American people, to guarantee free childcare for all. A common sense policy that would protect our children while saving parents their paychecks and make it easier to keep their jobs. Jill’s plan to guarantee free childcare even supports businesses who lose “$1,640 on average for each working parent due to lost revenue and hiring costs because of insufficient child care” as of a 2023 Ready Nation . When it comes time to vote, we already know that Donald Trump wouldn’t guarantee free childcare and Joe Biden can’t guarantee free childcare. Jill will guarantee free childcare saving families thousands every year, but she needs your ongoing support to challenge empire to get on the ballot across the nation now and win in November. Peter, will you contribute what you can today to help make Jill’s plan become a reality? | "DONATE" Don’t forget to check out the rest of Jill’s platform here: | "Jill's Plans" Thank you for being part of the movement for people, planet, and peace. In 1999, the late-great Arkansas Senator Dale Bumpers said this in the impeachment trial of President William Jefferson Clinton:
> **" We're here today because the President suffered a terrible moral lapse, a marital infidelity; not a breach of the public trust, not a crime against society, the two things Hamilton talked about in Federalist Paper number 65 -- I recommend it to you before you vote -- but a breach of his marriage vows.**
> **It was a breach of his family trust.**_**It is a sex scandal.**_**H.L. Mencken said one time, "When you hear somebody say, 'This is not about money' -- it's about money. And when you hear somebody say, 'This is not about sex'...it's about sex."1**
Bill Clinton offered the best skillset my party has to offer America: empathy for working families; analytical brilliance; and a talent for executing data-driven policy through the complex machinery of constitutional government. As far as modern Democratic politicians go, in my view, Bill is [the GOAT.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7d8befb3-74ef-46d0-bfd7-3932dcbbf10d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But he also fucked around. A lot. He lied with reckless abandon, perjuring himself many times, and obstructing justice seemingly in his sleep. He cheated on his wife repeatedly and was credibly accused of rape by multiple women going back to his days as a Rhodes Scholar at Oxford, as Attorney General of Arkansas, and then as Governor. He flew on Jeffrey Epstein's jet, which, of course is not a crime. But it sure doesn't look _great_.
So knowing what I know, if he was on my ballot this November, would I vote for Bill Clinton? Absolutely, enthusiastically -- and without hesitation.
When I vote for politicians, I'm not electing them to a sainthood. I don't know what they do in their private lives, and I don't _want_ to know. I just assume it's not pretty.
I am hiring them to do a job: to run _public_ life. And at that job, speaking as a longtime student of politics, Bill is one of the best I have seen.
You may or may not think Donald is one of the best _you_ have seen. I certainly think he isn't impressive in office. But half the country does. And that's the point: if you would give a pass to Bill -- and I would -- then you must, in fairness, give a pass to Donald. So I do. Otherwise, I would be a braindead partisan hack.
That's why when I heard the same people who helped elect Bill Clinton wax poetic yesterday about how presidents must be held to a high moral standard yada yada yada, I didn't believe them.
Democrats want you to believe this conviction is about democracy, not sex. Just as Republicans in '99 wanted you to believe the Lewinsky scandal was about the rule of law, not sex. But an objective onlooker can see that both cases are obviously about sex. These cases were brought to humiliate presidents on the national stage. In both cases, "independent" prosecutors succeeded in doing just that.
Sex and politics -- that's all this case was ever about.
And when it comes to the sex lives of our politicians, Democrat or Republican, my gut feeling remains the same:
_I don 't care._
Donald Trump has almost certainly committed crimes against democracy of which a jury should convict him beyond a reasonable doubt.2
This was not one of them.

I just assume it's not pretty. I am hiring them to do a job: to run public life. And at that job, speaking as a longtime student of politics, Bill is one of the best I have seen. You may or may not think Donald is one of the best you have seen. I certainly think he isn't impressive in office. But half the country does. And that's the point: if you would give a pass to Bill -- and I would -- then you must, in fairness, give a pass to Donald. So I do. Otherwise, I would be a braindead partisan hack. That's why when I heard the same people who helped elect Bill Clinton wax poetic yesterday about how presidents must be held to a high moral standard yada yada yada, I didn't believe them. Democrats want you to believe this conviction is about democracy, not sex. Just as Republicans in '99 wanted you to believe the Lewinsky scandal was about the rule of law, not sex. But an objective onlooker can see that both cases are obviously about sex. These cases were brought to humiliate presidents on the national stage. In both cases, "independent" prosecutors succeeded in doing just that. Sex and politics -- that's all this case was ever about. And when it comes to the sex lives of our politicians, Democrat or Republican, my gut feeling remains the same: I don 't care. Donald Trump has almost certainly committed crimes against democracy of which a jury should convict him beyond a reasonable doubt.2 This was not one of them. | | ---|---|--- 1 # at 00:18:14 2 ; | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Aditya Pai 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

Friends,

I think I figured out why Nick LaLota doesn't open his mouth in the district much - it's because when he does, it's such far-right Trump flunky talk that shows how out of touch he is with the basic American Values that should unite us:

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-tg [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-tg]

Equal justice under the law is a fundamental American value. It’s not evidence of a Banana Republic. Here's a reality check for Nick: A Banana Republic is when you want to pardon a criminal because they’re from your political party. A Banana Republic is when a candidate promises to pardon people who attacked the US Capitol on his behalf.

That's what Nick LaLota wants. And are you surprised at all that a MAGA Trumpublican is scrambling to bend the knee to a convicted felon? I'm not. Just like when he abandoned the bipartisan border bill at Trump’s behest, Nick LaLota does whatever Trump says. Suffolk County deserves better.

Make no mistake. The fact that a former president was convicted by a jury of his peers is a triumph for the rule of law.

We can't let LaLota and the rest of the MAGA minions delegitimize this. That starts when Nick LaLota is fired by Suffolk County voters this fall. And that only happens if the Democrats put forward a candidate who can win the general election.

Want a banana republic? That's LaLota's fantasy. Want to start bringing people together and actually get to work? That's why I'm running for Congress, and I hope you'll join me. Together we can fight the good fight and win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-tg]

-John

IR EXCLUSIVE
Rep. Ronny Jackson: Biden "Cognitively Impaired" as White House Physician, First Lady Involved in the Greatest Health Cover-up Since Pres. Woodrow Wilson (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/rep-ronny-jackson-biden-cognitively-disabled-as-white-house-physician-first-lady-involved-in-the-greatest-health-cover-up-since-pres-woodrow-wilson.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8f147ecb6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

By Illinois Review
U.S. Rep. Ronny Jackson (R-TX), who served as White House Physician to Presidents Barack Obama and Donald Trump, spoke with Illinois Review on Wednesday to discuss President Joe Biden’s rapid cognitive decline and the three people involved in one of the greatest health cover-ups in presidential history since Woodrow Wilson: White House Physician Dr. Kevin O’Connor, First Lady Jill Biden and White House Chief of Staff Jeff Zients.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/rep-ronny-jackson-biden-cognitively-disabled-as-white-house-physician-first-lady-involved-in-the-greatest-health-cover-up-since-pres-woodrow-wilson.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8f147ecb6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

“The president’s physician, the First Lady and the president’s chief of staff should be getting together and figuring out how they’re going to get themselves out of this – this man’s not cognitively fit to be there,” Rep. Jackson shared with this publication. “But the reason why they won’t do this is because it’s not just them, it’s everybody in the West Wing – everybody that works in the White House right now. Their political power, their influence, their authority is tied directly to the fact that he’s President of the United States.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/rep-ronny-jackson-biden-cognitively-disabled-as-white-house-physician-first-lady-involved-in-the-greatest-health-cover-up-since-pres-woodrow-wilson.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8f147ecb6f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Rep. Jackson, who knew Biden well when he was Obama’s presidential physician, said Jill Biden in particular always had oversized political ambitions, saying, “Jill Biden wanted to be First Lady more than she wanted her next breath. And that was so obvious at the time – and I think that’s still the case.”

The former White House physician continued, “And they will do anything to keep him in power because his power translates into their power and their authority and their influence – and the day he leaves the White House, they also leave the White House and they no longer have that privilege.”

Folks, I’m stressed.
Our end-of-month deadline is tonight, and if I’m being honest, we’re not where we need to be.
I’m usually not this worried about fundraising. But since this is one of the last deadlines before the general election kicks off, I’m pretty concerned because it could make or break this grassroots campaign.
Mitch McConnell and his cronies are just waiting for us to make a mistake and capitalize on any weaknesses they can find.
And if we fall short now, we’ll be off track during the most critical period of this race. So I’m turning to you:
Folks, will you split $10 or any amount that works for your budget between my campaign and Seth Moulton today? I depend on your grassroots support to power my campaign, so anything you can give will make a difference. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]

Thank you for everything,

| | Hi Peter, I want to make sure you saw Britney’s email about OLCV’s impact in the primary election. The results make it clear that OLCV’s endorsement makes a difference and climate is a winning issue. 73 out of the 78 races where we made an endorsement ended with a victory or a runoff in November. Two Salem City Council races are still too close to call, so we’ll keep watching those as ballots continue to be tallied. OLCV Executive Director | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86013991/476557700/-1918275715?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYyYWQzMDBiLTZiMWYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=vnO5SJNaXQJ0AYXNYdt2qLg6qPRbIbH6BHf90-GPxn8=&emci=9b0afefe-bd1e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f2ad300b-6b1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, Climate voters showed up for this primary election, and helped deliver victories to nearly all of OLCV’s endorsed candidates and ballot measures! I just got out of a meeting where our team at the California Democratic Party had to make a tough decision.
We just got word this past week that the GOP’s primary super PAC for House races is preparing to spend over $30,000,000 in our state to elect Republicans in swing districts.
We know that we have to respond to all this dark money with more grassroots organizing — but we don’t have that kind of cash in our back pocket.
Lots of donors have stepped up ahead of our End of Month deadline, but as of an hour ago, we are still $8,350.50 short of where we need to be.
So, we had to make a call:
(1) Will we accelerate our mobilization efforts in the hope that our grassroots supporters will help us close the budget gap?
(2) Or will we hold off, potentially letting Republican dark money overwhelm our candidates in critical, must-win seats?
We decided to keep growing our mobilization program at full speed.
But now we need to close this $8,350.50 gap and go into the last month of Q2 at full speed.

I know it’s asking a lot, but if you could please pitch in $20 and help us close the gap, I really think we can do it.** **Here’s a secure link to donate:** **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/Salinasq22024?refcode=email_053124_EOM4](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86019781/476574842/1744833800?refcode=email_053124_EOM4&amounts=10,20,50,75,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDhlNDUzZS03MjFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ww8M5_-liDMfnUv4WfjHEQqnVMGO4K5vpZtlrbihxWY=)** Listen, I know it’s nerve-racking how close this next election is looking. Dear Friend, I know a lot of us in the Valley feel like we live here in "Forgotten Fresno." At least that's how Joe Biden and Jim Costa treat us. We definitely are their last priority in how they govern.

Rising gas prices, increasing grocery bills, and skyrocketing utility costs are making it more and more challenging for our Valley families to make ends meet. And these costs can all be traced back to increasing federal taxes and out-of-control spending by Biden and Costa.

It's time for a change! Let's bring quality leadership back to the Valley. Will you help send me to Congress to represent our Valley families and bring our values and priorities to Washington D.C.?

Team Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

An attorney for former President Donald Trump on Friday sent a "cease and desist" letter to Rep. Bob Good, warning his campaign to stop using Mr. Trump's name and likeness in campaign materials that falsely suggest his support.
---
|
---
| This picture is from the Trump campaign's letter
It escalates the hostile relationship between Mr. Trump, the presumptive Republican presidential nominee, and Mr. Good, the chair of the House Freedom Caucus.
The letter comes just days after Mr. Trump endorsed Mr. Good's Republican primary opponent, John McGuire.
Trump attorney David A. Warrington said in the letter that they were informed Mr. Good's campaign was producing yard signs "purporting to indicate President Trump's endorsement of your candidacy." The letter included a photograph of a yard sign that had Mr. Trump's name listed above Mr. Good's name.

body:

| Dear Peter -
The conviction of President Trump is a disgraceful moment for our country, when activism and emotion trampled long standing judicial principles and standards.
This case is ripe to be overturned on appeal, as it should be, and Donald Trump will be reelected in November.
Ultimately this will blow up in the left's smirking, pretentious little faces. Donald Trump reportedly raised nearly $40 million online in the immediate hours after the conviction, which is evidence that this is already backfiring on those who are cheering in the aftermath of this disgrace.
I want to use this campaign brief to share a few pieces of analysis, both legal and political, about this conviction, what it means for the upcoming election, and what it means for our country moving forward.
In Service,
---
|
---
| Dan Crenshaw
---
|
[Daily Wire: Ben Shapiro - Trump Found Guilty. Pray For The Republic.](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K0JqHBC1ZZ2erBmEySjiWYlJlflqhlu9B5PK3xp4in7nTNmgdp1rQCzXR8_c6ucAg5pUNzgQLmyJoeX2Hu7WKJ4WUuJb5vcujY1GbF766ohO-nIA6xmuodGEYqi5_O3GEaVjYefIkcEXP09KDmKH0efzh7RsuGjzcmxgeEXLh4Tk2EmGaSoqkgV3OoGMjcjCRLjRbx_y82R_x0dffNgu6Q==&c=ZpgBOVYgWaMhJXVYFU3dwncrMW_6Q-MNXdyYt-Qhc4rbvQYaZWlOig==&ch=09Q12w0rJDzcLM2UCYW1E3qycj5gEaZXZ9rXf1cKLt-tzZ9TNlBd-w==)
It's a travesty of justice.
This case was a joke from the very beginning. Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg, who set this entire thing up to become more famous and more powerful. Judge Juan Merchan, who basically gave every benefit to the prosecution and whose jury instructions were unprecedented in their willingness to flout the law.
This was all set up to convict Donald Trump simply so the Democrats could either jail Donald Trump or spend the next few months declaring Donald Trump a convicted felon for purposes of the 2024 election.
The actual methodology by which he was found guilty is utterly uncertain. The reality is there were two crimes alleged: a misdemeanor falsification of business records -- which would not have resulted in any possible jail time -- but to become a felony that was reliant on other unspecified crimes.
[National Review: Make No Mistake: The Trump Case Was an Unprecedented Application of the Law](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K0JqHBC1ZZ2erBmEySjiWYlJlflqhlu9B5PK3xp4in7nTNmgdp1rQCzXR8_c6ucAFljyLyYbAQ-fW6CWPwNI16WWaS5cDo9gFrCEfR5vfWK7lCu9Mjip43kMqDxLSLT3C65X9VLrY0QpEwUuQZYoWm7NFeA4HwNlAHAoQk4taUze08lZ1U64cateGqEpPUxwaaaVvptcvSBsj0Nv0xImQPp_bOjMJvqEpG7gLgpdwDTP-GOVuyv-gH2uFNkCIdk4pXnLFSZSLr0fixrMI5TAfaBHll1rF6Uv&c=ZpgBOVYgWaMhJXVYFU3dwncrMW_6Q-MNXdyYt-Qhc4rbvQYaZWlOig==&ch=09Q12w0rJDzcLM2UCYW1E3qycj5gEaZXZ9rXf1cKLt-tzZ9TNlBd-w==)
The typical Democratic talking point since early last night is that "no one is above the law." What was applied here was not the law; it was a unique interpretation of an infrequently enforced statute that had never been used before. At first glance, the statute of limitations had expired, but Bragg convinced the judge that Trump's time outside of the state, including his four years as president, didn't count. ... Trump is facing four years in prison for each of the 34 counts -- conceivably 136 years in prison, although some doubt he will serve any time as a first-time offender -- for the crime of listing his payment to Michael Cohen as an ongoing legal fee rather than a loan reimbursement. That's it, that's the crime.
Mind you, under this same district attorney, Alvin Bragg, "Armed robbers who use guns or other deadly weapons to stick up stores and other businesses will be prosecuted only for petty larceny, a misdemeanor, provided no victims were seriously injured and there's no 'genuine risk of physical harm' to anyone. . . . Convicted criminals caught with weapons other than guns will have those felony charges downgraded to misdemeanors unless they're also charged with more serious offenses."
[Wall Street Journal: A Guilty Verdict for Trump and Its Consequences for the Country](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K0JqHBC1ZZ2erBmEySjiWYlJlflqhlu9B5PK3xp4in7nTNmgdp1rQCzXR8_c6ucAG2HTeAvfv73yNPEfZohrrtcG-PpfYcOzg60qdVnSS5IXts24WYBLC_Ufe9f4WJ3OIQDO_XTO1-Q0DN3PLB9rurMZS8h-x5Emf1FeEeutF85qznuTN-aj_61DHhQ9ayiX-GVLAv8nUlpMgBZfZp2nzTzlJtObtfXQe5-TbMnvdq4cc6dAJFcGGT9rMEiCTFayHsP-QTUINCydi2_DhHr-qrWiCGyvmv8pOWEa-PFMbSJfxQMht6tkgQ_BgZbb2vuK&c=ZpgBOVYgWaMhJXVYFU3dwncrMW_6Q-MNXdyYt-Qhc4rbvQYaZWlOig==&ch=09Q12w0rJDzcLM2UCYW1E3qycj5gEaZXZ9rXf1cKLt-tzZ9TNlBd-w==)
On the law, though, the case was a bizarre turducken, with alleged crimes stuffed inside other crimes. By the time Mr. Bragg showed up on the scene, the Stormy business was old enough that Mr. Trump couldn't be hit with misdemeanor falsification of records, because the statute of limitations had expired. To elevate these counts into felonies, the DA said Mr. Trump cooked the books with an intent to commit or cover up a second offense.
What crime was that? At first Mr. Bragg was cagey. He eventually settled on a New York election law, rarely enforced, that prohibits conspiracies to promote political candidates "by unlawful means." This explains why prosecutors spent so much trial time on David Pecker, the National Enquirer boss. His outfit paid $150,000 in 2016 to silence another woman, Karen McDougal, who also says she had an extracurricular affair with Mr. Trump. Mr. Bragg's argument is that they were all in cahoots, more or less, to steal the election. ... A help to Mr. Bragg's prosecution is that the jurors were instructed that as long as they were unanimous that Mr. Trump was guilty of falsifying business records to aid or cover up an illegal conspiracy to get him elected, they didn't all have to agree about which theory of the "unlawful means" they found persuasive. Perhaps this will be taken up by Mr. Trump on appeal. He will almost certainly argue, too, that the Stormy payoff wasn't a campaign expense, as Brad Smith, a former chairman of the Federal Election Commission, has been arguing all along.
[Fox News: Does the guilty verdict destroy Trump or make him even stronger?](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K0JqHBC1ZZ2erBmEySjiWYlJlflqhlu9B5PK3xp4in7nTNmgdp1rQCzXR8_c6ucA5Xc-s-0WWcjOdcZ0zOGL0toEJFSIyMfAad5WVu83RzRbjU1URH7_p4VRD4IE2H1XpUBttGMO76KIe3N8Mn4bed8xhBB5zA5_Zb7N7lHieyg1SIY6PPMRS8anTK6DQyHijSry9GmwC7DDdg85bt42fBc-hyLFGDTYalDT99STdBetN53L2TQLkw==&c=ZpgBOVYgWaMhJXVYFU3dwncrMW_6Q-MNXdyYt-Qhc4rbvQYaZWlOig==&ch=09Q12w0rJDzcLM2UCYW1E3qycj5gEaZXZ9rXf1cKLt-tzZ9TNlBd-w==)
We asked the voters in last week's Harvard CAPS/Harris poll what they would do if Trump were convicted, and they said that a conviction in this case would make no difference. We will see if that prediction is true in the next few weeks. The best that the Democrats can do right now in this case is to say "the jury has spoken."
Partisan statements will only increase anger and cause the boomerang to increase. Many Democrats believe Donald Trump is a criminal, but those voters were already in the Democratic camp. The voters in the middle seem focused not on trials but on [issues like inflation](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K0JqHBC1ZZ2erBmEySjiWYlJlflqhlu9B5PK3xp4in7nTNmgdp1rQCzXR8_c6ucAriBeVeJZx_ma8arX1DasX-huGMH4wjaro2-EBo8GIIfin_rpPr_xOOrLpvgbT_6Xmzyimrv2dizIHrn2dRgvQ6Z6zAH5XgKS1vymHF5iJhuKFpL8dKdwgdF2HtYvod2OoJnHcC9k3PI=&c=ZpgBOVYgWaMhJXVYFU3dwncrMW_6Q-MNXdyYt-Qhc4rbvQYaZWlOig==&ch=09Q12w0rJDzcLM2UCYW1E3qycj5gEaZXZ9rXf1cKLt-tzZ9TNlBd-w==) and immigration. Ironically, the [president's son ](https://ufp8iicbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K0JqHBC1ZZ2erBmEySjiWYlJlflqhlu9B5PK3xp4in7nTNmgdp1rQCzXR8_c6ucAtkQPbH_qo6nCrabQpjDMOWBzmQH_NK_h5us1JC7kpaISOdxWhSiyr6LuAmraO_uCqX7wEFZ8mDeTm-oc62UcnNCfGDLwnWplhPOgmQu7zq0gvr1maTe128puuDLRgQX6&c=ZpgBOVYgWaMhJXVYFU3dwncrMW_6Q-MNXdyYt-Qhc4rbvQYaZWlOig==&ch=09Q12w0rJDzcLM2UCYW1E3qycj5gEaZXZ9rXf1cKLt-tzZ9TNlBd-w==)is scheduled to go on trial next week.
Our justice system simply can't operate this way in which pie-in-the-sky piled on charges can be hurled by political advocates to blunt the opposing presidential candidate.

body:
I was proud to stand on stage with Maryland Democrats at last week’s Unity Breakfast because the stakes in this election could not be any higher.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86021282/476579623/-2051496126?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTllNTc2Ny03NDFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z_j_IGrE3ai3fdeFUZd_NZ6ZW5-_KidNajQA3vXCfjg=&emci=1c550429-5b1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9a9e5767-741f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=30237190)
---
| I was proud to stand on stage with Maryland Democrats at last week’s Unity Breakfast because the stakes in this election could not be any higher.

We have to re-elect President Joe Biden. I joke that I am old enough to remember when the federal government worked –– because, under Joe Biden’s leadership, Congress passed the American Rescue Plan, the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, and the CHIPS and Science Act. America needs four more years of this kind of results-oriented leadership.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86021284/476579624/-2051496126?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTllNTc2Ny03NDFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z_j_IGrE3ai3fdeFUZd_NZ6ZW5-_KidNajQA3vXCfjg=&emci=1c550429-5b1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9a9e5767-741f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=30237190)
We must elect Angela Alsobrooks to the United States Senate. Maryland will decide control of the United States Senate, and Angela is the only candidate who will fight to protect reproductive freedom and to ban military-style assault weapons. We need a champion for our values in the Senate.

Closest to home –– and nearest to my heart –– we must elect pro-public education candidates to the Boards of Education in Anne Arundel, Howard, and Carroll Counties. We have to stand up to right-wing activists who will put their political agendas ahead of the interests of our students and educators. I was proud to campaign alongside Board of Ed candidates during the primary –– and will continue working hard for them through the general election.

I have never had an easy race, and I always run like I am ten points down. This year’s general election will be no different. In addition to supporting President Biden, Angela Alsobrooks, and our outstanding Board of Ed candidates, I will work hard to expand our coalition and win this race so I can be your voice in Congress.

There are 158 days left until Election Day. With your help, we will deliver resounding victories up and down the ballot in November.

Onward!

Sarah Elfreth

* * *

subject: Why I'm endorsing Taylor Darling for Senate District 6
body:
Why she's the best candidate to take my place in District 6 | | | | | |

---
|
Hello Friend, it's Senator Kevin Thomas—with the primary less than a month away, I have a message for you:
**Taylor Darling is the best candidate to replace me as State Senator.**
In her three terms in the Assembly, Taylor has fought for quality affordable healthcare, worked hard to improve our schools, and secured millions of dollars to improve our infrastructure.

---
[Friend, I know that Taylor will carry out my legacy of service as State Senator. The primary is less than a month away and the next public matching deadline is coming up next Monday. That means that eligible donations from district residents can be matched up to 12X—$5 can turn into $60. Can you support Taylor's campaign while a little bit will still go a long way?](https://actblue.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f37076f57a46237229b5286f&id=893f5a74a9&e=337fa576ef)
[Support Taylor!](https://actblue.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f37076f57a46237229b5286f&id=913b9496c3&e=337fa576ef)
| I know Taylor Darling is the best candidate to replace me – just look at her track record of service as a State Assemblywoman.
---
|
1️⃣ **Taylor has fought for access to quality affordable healthcare.** She secured over $800 million for distressed hospitals – including Nassau University Medical Center.
2️⃣ **Taylor has fought for our infrastructure.** Her biggest accomplishment? Securing $450 million dollars to fill the prolific potholes that plague Long Island roads.
3️⃣ **Taylor is a proud advocate for public education.** Not only did she secure $35.9 billion in record education funding but she also created the first pre-apprenticeship program in NY State.
---
[Friend, that is why I firmly endorse Taylor Darling's historic campaign to be the first woman to represent the 6th Senate District and the first Black senator to represent Long Island in the State Senate. Taylor has effectively served Long Island for years and will continue to do so in the State Senate. Can you chip in today before the public funds matching deadline next Monday?](https://actblue.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f37076f57a46237229b5286f&id=597372c27a&e=337fa576ef)

I’m hosting the Innovation Leadership Circle Retreat this weekend, joining forces with my colleagues from Capitol Hill, social activists, and 100 of our country’s technology leaders to discuss how we strengthen our economy in an ever-changing landscape of progress.

Democrats must remain the party of the future when it comes to the economy. By working together across diverse fields, we can be the party of innovation and entrepreneurship, the party that fosters the growth of intergenerational wealth and expands economic opportunity. That means creating good-paying union jobs and supporting working-class families by making a moonshot investment in manufacturing. We’re already making progress by creating millions of jobs through the CHIPS Act and the Inflation Reduction Act.
