body:
| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/254864ccec29/im-running-and-i-need-your-support-12698683?e=8c80cba7e7)
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=dd69cc53bc&e=8c80cba7e7)
| Hello Friends!
It has been a busy few weeks, and I wanted to give you an update on our campaign for Pennsylvania State House in District 28! Scroll to the bottom for info about our upcoming events and volunteer needs!
**Progressives are Desperate to Maintain Control**
Our Pennsylvania State Government has the only divided state legislature in the country. Republicans narrowly control the State Senate and Democrats control the State House by the slimmest of margins, 102-101. Yes, there is just a 1 vote margin out of 203 members. However, that 1 vote margin makes all the difference. With that single vote, progressives are able to set the House calendar, decide which bills come up for a vote, and even stack committee memberships in their favor. This one vote margin also allows the majority to set the rules. Earlier in May, we saw just one egregious example of how the Democrats twisted the rules in their favor. One Democrat member of the House from Philadelphia had an arrest warrant out against him. He was literally a fugitive from the law for a week. Unbelievably, during the time he was being pursued by law enforcement, he was casting votes in the PA House via proxy – another member voting for him! You cannot make this craziness up! This highlights the importance of winning PA 28 and others to regain control of the House.
With the Progressives desperate to maintain control, we are seeing huge amounts of national left-wing money flowing into Pennsylvania since we are one of only a handful of swing states from the presidential level all the way down to the State House. Democrats have identified 15 State House seats they are targeting to hold or flip. PA 28 – our district – is one of them. This is why I need your help even more. There is something for everyone to do, from helping put up door hangers, addressing postcards, making yard signs, and donating so we can get our message out.

**Honoring our Fallen – Memorial Day Events**
---
| Memorial Day is a time to remember and honor those who paid the ultimate sacrifice so that we may have this great country and freedom that we enjoy today. My family and I were honored to be able to take part in several events throughout Northern Allegheny County, starting off the day in the Township of Pine for a flag raising service in Old Wexford and the kick-off of the Military Banners program. Next, American Legion Post 593 held an excellent parade and moving ceremony in Richland Park. From the C- 17 Globemaster flyover to the ringing of the restored Navy Ship’s Bell, it helped all to put in perspective the sacrifices that have been made. It was good to be able to talk with the Post 593 members and public. Finally, American Legion Post 598 in West Deer had numerous events throughout the day, culminating in a mid-day ceremony and luncheon. I appreciate all the preparation and work done to remember our fallen servicemen and women. It was an honor for me to be able to speak at the luncheon and express my gratitude.

**Critical Fundraising Events**
While we have a tremendous volunteer army, we also need monetary resources to be able to fully get our message out to swing voters across District 28. Out-of-state Progressives are targeting District 28 along with 14 other districts in Pennsylvania. Collectively, these 7% of districts -- 15 out of 203 – will determine the direction of Pennsylvania. With our strong message and volunteer base, we don’t need to match their deluge of spending dollar for dollar, but we do need to keep it close. A donation of any size, would greatly help our efforts and be appreciated!
---
[DONATE](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=e4d663d17f&e=8c80cba7e7)
| Join us at two upcoming fundraising events! Please come to our community “Friendraising Picnic” on June 30th at 3PM in Pine Park. We would love for you to sponsor and/or attend! There will be good food and fellowship, along with opportunities to volunteer. You can pick up yard signs, door hangers, postcards, etc. to help prepare for the fall.
---
| We are also holding an event at the Duquesne Club on June 25th , and we are looking for sponsors. If you are able to attend or sponsor one or both events, it would be greatly appreciated!
---
| **How to Help**
One of the most common questions we get asked is “How can we help?” There are so many things that can be done with volunteers! There is literally something for everyone. Here is a list of just some of the activities we need help with:
\- Put door hangers on doors in your neighborhood\- Address postcards/envelopes\- Help man a booth at an event\- Make phone calls to target/swing voters\- Put together yard signs\- Host a Meet and Greet at your house\- Invite Jeremy to speak at a club or group
If you can help, just reply to this email and let us know what you are interested/able to do and we will get you connected!
Thank you again for your continued support.
Respectfully,
---

# Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

This comes down to who you trust

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2193%2E4032634%2EYaxJPB)

Last night Donald Trump was found guilty of falsifying business records and illegally influencing the 2016 election. Of course, his response is that he's a victim of a corrupt legal system. And this has mobilized his MAGA base — the Trump campaign said they have raised $34.8 million from small dollar donors since last night’s verdict. [**This man is still going to be the Republican nominee for president. And in order to keep him out of the White House, we need to do everything we can to compete against his money, influence, and loyalist base. So can you please split a donation of $28 to support the Biden-Harris campaign and our pro-democracy movement today?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2219?amount=28&t=8&akid=2193%2E4032634%2EYaxJPB) | [**DONATE**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2219?amount=28&t=9&akid=2193%2E4032634%2EYaxJPB)
---
Nobody can be surprised about this reaction. When the election did not come out the way Donald Trump wanted in 2020, what was his response then? It was violence. It was to undermine our institutions of government. It was to impose a loyalty test on any Republican in public office to either support him or leave.
That’s what this election is about. While Democrats are fighting to protect our democracy, Republicans are fighting to protect their power. They have made clear they will say whatever they need to say, kiss up to Donald Trump in any way, in order to seize power — even if it means electing the first president who has been convicted of a crime.
**This is about who you trust to be the leader of this country. And I trust Joe Biden.**
[**So please, rush a donation of $28 or anything you can so we can compete against their $34 million haul and fight for our democracy.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2219?amount=28&t=10&akid=2193%2E4032634%2EYaxJPB)

Elizabeth

Hi Friend, it’s Sen. Brad Pfaff, reaching out with an urgent message. **Ahead of today's End of Month Fundraising Deadline, my team and I still need $2,380 to meet our goal.** [**Reaching these goals is crucial to defending my seat against my well-funded GOP opponent. ---
[ **DONATE BEFORE MIDNIGHT** ](https://bp4wi.us/l/lTQDkyPhyVQa)
---
Friend, growing up on a family farm, my parents instilled the importance of community in me from a very young age. We shared all the responsibilities of running the farm, whether it was waking up at the break of dawn to feed the animals or staying out late to make sure all the crops were tended to. **Needless to say, small farmers and working families are very near and dear to my heart.** I’m proud of everything I’ve accomplished for them – **and with you as part of my coalition, I want to keep fighting for 1️⃣ lower healthcare and prescription drugs costs, 2️⃣ higher worker wages and more economic opportunities for Wisconsinites, 3️⃣ better roads and essential infrastructure and 4️⃣ expanded support and resources for our farmers and working families.** Now, I'm running for re-election because the work to make Wisconsin better isn't over. But as we work to beat my GOP opponent, my team and I need your help to secure essential campaign materials, connect with voters, and share my passion for serving our residents! [**Our End of Month Fundraising Deadline is the perfect opportunity to show your support. But time is running out to meet our goal – will you help me reach it by rushing a donation of $15, $35, or $50 before midnight?**](https://bp4wi.us/l/ubP5x5d3VLE1)

Thank you, Sen. Brad Pfaff

Milford Hayes here, Jahana’s husband. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86027316/476596294/-1295403277?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240531_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDlhOWRkMS03YjFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZrdGgKVL8j48aaMULlbiFnX_gLrVyHx8oUID9HRLuDA=&emci=6a3d11f9-741f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=609a9dd1-7b1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15529135) | Hello there — Milford Hayes here, Jahana’s husband. I know you do not hear from me often, but there is something I’d like you to know about my wife and our household. You see, we may pay a little more attention to the integrity of our justice system than most. For more than 27 years, I have served in law enforcement, starting as a rookie police officer before spending the majority of my career as a detective, investigating major crimes and continuing in various roles within the police department. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86027317/476596296/880646440?contactdata=jqzRkopY0xIkyYQZVCJ7iW+UYWv+grwUBOd9g3DDdWXoRhgjeQQsUTyRdT1ro0ZfcixBOuzQISAzl0uJ8EwV1BOJud93TLh0RMmlXMbTQlyiLPHjKQ2u8gJN6C6JxFa8citqQk7t+x96MGMiPm+2eA==&refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240531_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDlhOWRkMS03YjFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZrdGgKVL8j48aaMULlbiFnX_gLrVyHx8oUID9HRLuDA=) I have spent my entire adult life working to defend the rule of law. I’ve investigated crimes and testified under oath as a witness. I have deep respect for the role judges, juries, prosecutors and even criminal defense attorneys play in upholding our system of justice. I have sat with families as a verdict was rendered and there have been times when a jury reached a verdict that I did not agree with. However, I have never cast doubt, or lost faith in the integrity of our system of justice. I believe in it! I know where my wife stands on this issue. I know Jahana supports the rule of law and I know she will work to preserve and protect our democracy. Donald Trump and his surrogates are casting doubt on the integrity of our justice system and undermining the work of so many dedicated public servants. Jahana’s opponent has refused to say whether he will support Trump in November. This is important to me and should be important to you. Does George Logan believe in our justice system? The rule of law? I know where our household stands. That is why it has never been more important to stand with Jahana in this historic time for our country. **This is about right and wrong** , and we deserve leaders with courage and moral clarity. We deserve more than Donald Trump and George Logan. We need to keep Jahana in Congress — and I’m asking for your help. [**Every single donation her campaign receives really matters — in fact, your $3 could make the difference in this election. I've been a bit of a troublemaker in Washington for, well, decades. And I’m proud to still be at it. Throughout my life, I’ve always found activism to be the best antidote to despair. I even spent my 82nd birthday in jail for protesting government inaction on the climate emergency _(Can you believe it? There weren’t any cakes or candles...)_ And you know what? I wear each arrest like a badge of honor because I was fighting for what I believe in. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86027961/476597811/2105508926?refcode=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImExMTc5ZGUwLTdjMWYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2gDA6uGWpFbrNAy7HZnNrE0QC67lrBKihQFs8E8tSy0=) _Jane’s iconic mugshot from 1970 after the Nixon White House had her arrested in Cleveland in 1970._ For me, nonviolent disobedience is one of the most powerful tools we have in our arsenal; it’s why those in power are always trying to [take it away from us.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86027962/476597812/1080487372?refcode=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImExMTc5ZGUwLTdjMWYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2gDA6uGWpFbrNAy7HZnNrE0QC67lrBKihQFs8E8tSy0=&emci=426099e5-be1e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105) Engaging in nonviolent disobedience invites you to put your body — your actions — in alignment with your values and goals. Doing so calls attention to the issue, sways public opinion, mobilizes large numbers of people, and creates change. Every time I stood, spoke, or sat in defiance, it was driven by my firm belief in collective action. When people come together, particularly at critical moments, we can make history. **And this November is our next big test, team: We're facing the most consequential election for climate action in our lifetimes. We’re the _last_ generation who still has a chance to force meaningful change that could mean saving lives and species on a vast scale. [That’s why I’m humbly asking for your support today. Even a donation as small as $5 can power our vital work at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86027963/476597813/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImExMTc5ZGUwLTdjMWYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2gDA6uGWpFbrNAy7HZnNrE0QC67lrBKihQFs8E8tSy0=)** | [**DONATE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86027964/476597814/2105508926?amount=5&refcode=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.a1179de0-7c1f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImExMTc5ZGUwLTdjMWYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2gDA6uGWpFbrNAy7HZnNrE0QC67lrBKihQFs8E8tSy0=)

As you know by now, President Trump was convicted yesterday on all 34 counts of the sham charges brought against him. This blatant miscarriage of justice doesn't say anything about President Trump; it shows just how far Democrats will go to take him down. They set up a political circus with a [super-progressive prosecutor](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fc2546762a3e4106b4a881693f9c6192&_e=_-TJmD9wsWG65E2xeCXkH4FHqF8MaB7aKcNFsYOEuS-6yaoNxekBePp9EhFGx4jUy6UI3W1J4XIOXdBX9X6JWGAkz4C1JijopCFMN7J4812VzE8B8n_j0BrnQs09ttxncYzxwOtmUD3SZy9IedKIl_ps6FnxLcQs_c2iWAEwaK20jspFilV34hFvblfsC8kYbzbBIYQVFusK3C8HScuIfpBDmiHiGo1vNf5GHP5kG32W42uYv9W1JXabdtE2C69frzJSAa9us4vge-GOe3MM5s8e5p-q4HKVztmz029h3lg%3D) who promised to charge Trump, a [judge](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=fc2546762a3e4106b4a881693f9c6192&_e=_-TJmD9wsWG65E2xeCXkH7-L0opUUAtoOA6yUsGAgmw-VNEzzz6ayjKEHPDF8-AG-2eZEPCLZyhu4D8Jj6rbCtRSDdGbrozx5IgOCIVY5zDBhl0lfpslUnNhmf3i2Yg6DIlnjhyGDhwlYEpQU_3n4FXJA_1DaLwGdTEKzeZrKsTmKQOPbxdiHU_4X2lppv8wOuXOzSgLtFo73PIu34q1MadEi94V_o4bjO0PiuCxqKBhfSS_d8_Op6Vr677a-sI0w313u8gKZTXaRLq7TCp3rL_IxF9xHpLHL-5WzSd24wM%3D) who donated to President Biden, and a jury from one of the most liberal areas in America. I’m not surprised at the verdict, but I’m more than disappointed. This was in a deep blue state, the statute of limitations was changed, and they turned a misdemeanor into a felony to keep him off the campaign trail. We’ll wait for an appeal, but this is not the America we once knew. At the end of the day, this was a dirty political game and the most blatant case of election interference in American history. It was all by design to create a massive roadblock between President Trump and the White House, but the people can see right through it. The Left may have made a mockery of our justice system in their desperation to remain in power, but the real verdict is coming in November.

Rough news, Peter – I just finished the last budget meeting of the month with my finance team, and they told me we’re still $11,428 short of our May fundraising goal.

It’s _really_ important that we finish the month strong.

See, everything we raise now determines whether we can scale up our 2024 student organizing efforts, hire more campaign staff, and expand our voter outreach to bring more people into our movement – so we really can’t fall short of this goal.

Most people assume that if something goes terribly wrong with their pregnancy—a serious risk to their health or a fatal fetal diagnosis—they can make the decision to terminate in consultation with their doctor. As women across the country are finding out, _exceptions to abortion bans are an empty promise_ and it is dangerous to be pregnant in any state that bans abortion.
> "We all deserve bodily autonomy," said lead plaintiff Amanda Zurawski. "Every day, people in Texas are being told that they have no options. It's sickening and wrong."
Our team filed this groundbreaking lawsuit in March 2023 seeking to clarify the scope of the state's "medical emergency" exception under its extreme abortion bans. In total, we represent 20 women who were denied emergency abortion care and two physicians.

Texas's decision today is deeply offensive to the women we represent and all pregnant people who are being unconscionably forced to beg their elected officials for their right to control their own bodies.

Here is what we’re up against
#

We all know Donald Trump:
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240531-2-15&t=1&akid=8212%2E3935704%2ENKELMO)
Here, you can see him donning a hat with his now-infamous campaign slogan, “Make America Great Again.” Yet when Donald Trump was president, he allowed gun homicides to spike 34% under his leadership.
That doesn’t sound so great to us.
At the NRA convention this month, Trump told a crowd of supporters that if he were reelected, he would begin rolling back President Biden’s gun safety policies on day one. We can’t let him set foot back in the Oval Office.
See these two?
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240531-2-15&t=2&akid=8212%2E3935704%2ENKELMO)
On the right is Mike Johnson, Speaker of the House of Representatives. He’s a gun lobby-backed extremist who has pledged to block **_any**_ gun safety legislation from getting a vote. We need to take back the House by replacing the extremists who backed him with gun safety champions.
On the left is Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, who has spent his decades-long career in Washington cozying up to the gun lobby instead of putting in the work to keep our communities safe from gun violence.
Mitch is retiring this year, and we can be sure his replacement will be just as extreme in their views on gun safety. If we let extremists take back the Senate, it will be **_a huge setback**_ for our movement.
Now, see her?
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240531-2-15&t=3&akid=8212%2E3935704%2ENKELMO)

[**Please. Can Gabby count on you to make your first online donation today?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240531-2-15&t=4&akid=8212%2E3935704%2ENKELMO)

Fair, efficient, and simple are words you probably don't associate with our tax system. But what if they could be?

Unfortunately, the federal income tax is a complete mess.

It's not efficient, fair, or simple. It fosters tax avoidance and cheating and costs billions of dollars to administer. First proposed in 1981 by Hoover fellows Alvin Rabushka and Robert Hall, the flat tax was intended to simplify the federal tax system by replacing the progressive federal income tax system with a low and simple flat tax. They believed that the flat tax was the fairest, most efficient, simplest, and most workable tax plan.

The flat tax plan would give an enormous boost to the US economy by dramatically improving incentives to work, save, invest, and take entrepreneurial risks. It would also save taxpayers hundreds of billions in direct and indirect costs.

As we navigate the complexities of our present tax system, it becomes evident that change is necessary. The classic book, _The Flat Tax_ , critiques the flaws in our highly progressive tax structure and introduces a practical, efficient, and workable alternative.

Hall and Rabushka explain that:
* All income should be taxed once, and only once, at a uniform low rate.
* A flat tax would eliminate the distortions of the present tax treatment of business.
* It is not an academic abstraction but a workable solution that has been implemented in many countries.
* If meaningful, systematic tax reform is to succeed, it won't be birthed in Washington. It will come from millions of taxpayers demanding fairness in taxation.

That's why we want to share this Hoover Classic with as many Americans as possible, starting with you. By requesting your free copy of _The Flat Tax_ eBook, you not only gain access to invaluable insights but also become part of a community engaged in reshaping our thinking on taxation.

As you delve into the pages of _The Flat Tax_ , you'll discover not only the critique of the current system but a practical alternative that has been a guiding light for those seeking fairness, efficiency, and practicality.

Join us in unlocking the legacy of _The Flat Tax_. Claim your free copy now and become part of a movement for transformative ideas in tax reform. You can get your eBook copy here: [https://resources.hoover.org/the-flat-tax](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=22fcc7f70a414d44bf0b22eaabb30586&_e=la9VNKeN0pGlqrOkfXcToJS5V62Ia08LsDcFZucVXBya158AvvwvJs1WzfItGCN4CWoJajCpHSW0aeujdC2WbhMGUgLQExBI6tMKOVD1xEQurjx9VVqxsOtx9zEBy6LrAKmxh4cGWjGcy1B2l-KpqN92BmkOMOi6MG4ThnucHzr1_0F0UbWw6vw8QUDRUcN54w-cqoSnJn_Lam2TB2jjEvDN2afduLddrQ_uWZ6sa7Is5-_itFHrQPKnr60ODxSyHYKfBA7S_OQ4x7IYpDqoCGyZJ-Lg89XnOlQlUl3g_OPWHxQppyFbHVplhauj8u63DwqmdDlrZwwRW0_yJlfprPce3eqGIReYjASoPgN7D3w%3D)

Greg

| In this email:
1) Fundraising Deadline - Get our country back on the right track
2) Statement on Trump court case

Peter,

**Please help us reach our fundraising goal for the month of May. ** We **only have until midnight tonight** to meet this goal, but it is still doable if you make a donation now.

This is _the_ great opportunity. This is the year to win this open seat so that Republicans can keep the House. I will work to lower our costs for food and energy. I will work to close the border and to increase safety in our communities. I will work to help our economy be stronger again and to pass a balanced budget amendment.

Thank you for standing with me to bring common sense back to our government. Every amount is helpful towards our fundraising goal for May, ending at midnight tonight!

| | Statement on Trump Court Case:

_"Yesterday was a very sad day for American jurisprudence. The Rule of Law, on which our entire system of government depends, requires that the government prosecutes cases based solely on alleged violations of the law, not blatantly because of who the defendant is. Unfortunately in New York the exact opposite of that occurred. Yesterday's verdict showed that sadly, the Rule of Law is less important than politics and power to extreme leftists.

Our Constitution took a back seat to vengeful politics Thursday. For the average citizen, this "law-fare" has forever blurred the lines between the electoral system and the justice system. It is sad to see.

A Soros-funded prosecutor who ran on a platform of "get Trump"[1] [2], a judge whose daughter is raising millions of dollars for Democrats off of the case[3], and a jury in one of the most liberal places in the country convicted President Trump of a “business records” misdemeanor, for which the statute of limitations has expired[4].

That it was spun into 34 felonies is ludicrous, indefensible and barely explainable. This leftist prosecutor routinely lets violent criminals off the hook and endangers his fellow citizens in so doing[5]. The hypocrisy is especially jarring in this case.

No one is above the law, but so too no one is below it. No person except Joe Biden's primary political opponent would have been charged and prosecuted in this manner, on the flimsiest of grounds. Without the dispassionate Rule of Law, we won't have a country.

Having said this, I believe this court ruling will be appealed, and I believe the ruling will be overturned. Whether this happens before the November elections is uncertain at this time.

For now, I am very encouraged by the record-breaking outpouring of financial support for President Trump following the court case.[6] I also believe that we, as Americans, from all political parties who care about the Rule of Law, should pray for our nation, and we should pray for President Trump as he goes through this."_ Last night, I spoke with WFMD and made statements about the Trump court case. You can read about it by going to https://www.wfmd.com/2024/05/30/local-politician-reacts-to-trumps-verdict/.

Thanks again for all that you do to help restore common sense to DC.

If you can help by making a donation of any amount today or tomorrow, that would be a huge help.

For our country,
Neil

Derek, my father was born in Poland. When he was just 4 years old, he came to the United States as a Holocaust survivor and refugee of World War II.

His story is one of hard work and determination – of perseverance through the worst of human cruelty and violence.
In my work in Congress, I look to him for inspiration –**so, as the first Democrat in Chester County to hold a national seat in more than 165 years, I'm not going to let the GOP replace me with a far-right challenger who would inevitably be a rubber stamp on the chaos and harmful policies of Republicans in Washington.** We've got A LOT of work to do if we want to defend our progress in November. Here's where things stand:
**FIRST:** The GOP rallied their millionaire donors to target key Democratic seats like mine across the country.
**THEN:** Not one, not two, but THREE Republicans launched their campaigns to take my seat.
**NOW:** If we can't gather enough resources to resist the GOP's attacks, we'll risk losing this seat and all of the incredible progress we've made.

clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Wendy Dant Chester Named New State Representative Community leader Wendy Dant Chester was elected unanimously by a caucus of precinct committeepersons in District 71. She has extensive experience fighting for the people of Southern Indiana. Wendy served as the president and CEO of the economic development organization and chamber of commerce for Floyd and Clark Counties, One Southern Indiana for ten years. In the role she brought millions of dollars to the area to support hundreds of businesses. Rep. Dant Chester looks to continue the legacy of Rep. Rita Fleming in the Statehouse, who was a bipartisan problem solver for families in the district. New Lawsuit Challenges State Abortion Ban A new lawsuit was launched this week against the near-total abortion ban in Indiana. It argues that women are not able to receive the care they need, and were previously able to access before the ban. Families should not be forced into the impossible decision of ignoring their doctor’s orders or going to another state to get care. We will continue to advocate strongly for the repeal and overturn of this ban. Electing Jennifer McCormick as our next governor sends that message. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. State House candidate Matt McNally served his country in uniform, and knows it’s unacceptable that Indiana has the fourth-worst veteran suicide rate in the country. Matt is running to represent parts of Carmel and Westfield in Hamilton County. He is running to help address veterans issues, and build a state that truly supports all those who served. Friend, we are closing the curtains...

...On our May fundraising deadline. If we do not hit our goal, we could have to make some serious changes that could limit the likelihood of us winning in November. Following the verdict in Trump's rigged trial, this deadline has become the most important of our campaign. The Deep State is looking to bury MAGA, and we need every hand on deck if we want to stop them. [**> > That's why I'm reaching out today and humbly asking you for support. <<**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=6b11e6e4b77b49c9aeea37fcf74f7cc8&_e=35MBmZXfoEoas79X60TNzyo67hrJOQzVAAii175bJqA1LJSKgYXy9uhWEymB8qoSzQzPuWEzCNjQT6D4p3Do5CQ6IuSqpMRiYz_DBfE7Y5slwAwGTiz2GedY7XuhIK_ECxVcxhH1ExJxA2TzJY45GhMCg9zDgEIP2Sw4YgjcebWZtwyAbqXNC6TqOhREVFJuuVuS4cw134cH6iZ6RSVSC8XgggwukYFS3ZW8dJBc0BGOZaVJsgJ02rR7moFalP5ZIAItyem7iMrrgI6AoCh0L91sQdyZJ89MyNua1KKOELiWNwHrMcVzZM2QejeBCXah)
The truth is...this could be the last email you ever get from me. I want to be honest with you because far too many leaders in our country have lost the ability to do so.

Please keep reading until the end.

**The odds are stacked against us right now, but your support could change everything.**

My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

[](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=6b11e6e4b77b49c9aeea37fcf74f7cc8&_e=35MBmZXfoEoas79X60TNzyo67hrJOQzVAAii175bJqA1LJSKgYXy9uhWEymB8qoSzQzPuWEzCNjQT6D4p3Do5CQ6IuSqpMRiYz_DBfE7Y5slwAwGTiz2GedY7XuhIK_ECxVcxhH1ExJxA2TzJY45Guku643rahRfuHyvzOC_AIYYXFjqFpQb0pLBOvfsg3HF_yt0mXC3Ud_VM6moFaNs7Yh0424Uw3sFQEqCyjtNK8C52-76LI5psJTlap-IPB8lhCVypM0KNkulSWPTsMRTQrRKPe7FHy7rBB5ae1-F7CvdmjTCeHGowCmVtEQEYYgQ)
I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls.

**Now, I am also a Senate candidate in a crucial race in Indiana. The outcome of this election will determine if we can take back the Senate and stop our country from turning into a banana republic.**

Joe Biden and his Leftist collaborators aren't just turning the justice system against their political opponents. They are pouring millions into key races across the country to wipe out GOP candidates. But I won't let them win so easily.

[**We will bring a MAGA Majority to the US Senate so President Trump has the support and reinforcements necessary to put America FIRST.**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=6b11e6e4b77b49c9aeea37fcf74f7cc8&_e=35MBmZXfoEoas79X60TNzyo67hrJOQzVAAii175bJqA1LJSKgYXy9uhWEymB8qoSzQzPuWEzCNjQT6D4p3Do5CQ6IuSqpMRiYz_DBfE7Y5slwAwGTiz2GedY7XuhIK_ECxVcxhH1ExJxA2TzJY45Gkany6Tc3scRqy89oyRHzbuCQBIgIqbPZJQwxLFpTG2nPIl2EZwMeZ-unOiVcndzpc0X-D5XOWcutpR4kon4leSy7kdlvM0Ltw8DS0_UIAhncusYTtLzR9QOYbS5XZYiPZO0Cj7fZMO74O1LGI8epOt8dDegbuN0yWcFhRZDud0k)

With limited time remaining before our deadline, I had to reach out with a special request. I am not usually one to ask for help from anyone, but there is just no way we can reach our goal without you.

[**So, Patriot, will you chip in $15 or any amount to help me out this one time??**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=6b11e6e4b77b49c9aeea37fcf74f7cc8&_e=35MBmZXfoEoas79X60TNzyo67hrJOQzVAAii175bJqA1LJSKgYXy9uhWEymB8qoSzQzPuWEzCNjQT6D4p3Do5CQ6IuSqpMRiYz_DBfE7Y5slwAwGTiz2GedY7XuhIK_E4qKb8I6Uh5M2ZvNrKfks0OcTaXw6siQibYtOOBiuVIlNJ0itdjr6-mx3EP6YOG0qU2Azp9wjM4PRpL7-9-A7E1OyKBf5vBGGQBHJ7H3kbPZWYS9BjWP8htokYMUrhlXJ0LmSJeiODsZyD7QfgvxqZS_GyAi7LLwIj0i-gZ4bhK_15FPgaG95Tj7kZa0cihlD)

body:
Dear Friend:

Since we launched this campaign, we have sent out fewer fundraising appeals compared to other candidates. We try to stay true to our weekly updates, and commitment to our supporters by only reaching out to ask for financial assistance near the end of each month.

Today, we are reaching out because we pulled together our budget for the next few months and we are going to need your help to maintain the majority in the legislature.

Just this week I received a call from a new donor telling me how worried they were if the Democrats took over the legislature. My general election opponent will likely have about $2 million pouring in from out-of-state and even from foreign donors to help propel her campaign. Whereas, I am relying on you to help us invest in digital ads, mailers and signs to help us win this election.

We all know Biden’s border crisis has been an epic failure. They have been signing up illegals to vote to try to change the outcome of our November election.

Biden’s woke agenda has created massive inflation our great grandchildren will be on the hook.

I can't fix the DC Beltway.

Together, we can restore trust and integrity at the Arizona Capitol. We have until midnight tonight. Can you make a small investment to secure Arizona's future?

Thank you for your strong support and continued prayers!
Team Bolick

---
Friend -- As you may have heard, President Biden has apparently authorized Ukraine to use American-supplied weapons to launch strikes deep within Russian territory. After multiple attacks on Russian early warning radar systems at two different locations, this brings the world one perilous step closer to thermonuclear Armageddon. Given that we are months away from electing the leadership of our nation, one would expect robust debates, particularly among candidates for the presidency, as well as the congress, on the danger of the current strategic situation, but instead we have a kangaroo court in Manhattan distracting the nation with a trial against former President Donald Trump on whether he paid a prostitute hush money from the correct bank account. I am not endorsing Trump, or any candidate for President of the United States of America, but it should be clear to all citizens that they are being denied the right to have a debate on the direction of our nation, and are not even being asked whether they'd like to risk being incinerated in a nuclear war. In the State of New York, voters are disenfranchised without their knowledge, by the extremely challenging requirements to attain ballot status. Most voters have no idea how difficult it is to secure 45,000 valid signatures in six weeks, but wonder why there are so few viable candidates on the ballot. This outrageous task has forced my campaign to create a powerful team in the State of New York, so I've invited a few of the veterans from our petition drive to join me tonight to share their experience in interacting with hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers in order to be able to attain the objective.

clean_body: | | Friend -- As you may have heard, President Biden has apparently authorized Ukraine to use American-supplied weapons to launch strikes deep within Russian territory. After multiple attacks on Russian early warning radar systems at two different locations, this brings the world one perilous step closer to thermonuclear Armageddon. Given that we are months away from electing the leadership of our nation, one would expect robust debates, particularly among candidates for the presidency, as well as the congress, on the danger of the current strategic situation, but instead we have a kangaroo court in Manhattan distracting the nation with a trial against former President Donald Trump on whether he paid a prostitute hush money from the correct bank account. I am not endorsing Trump, or any candidate for President of the United States of America, but it should be clear to all citizens that they are being denied the right to have a debate on the direction of our nation, and are not even being asked whether they'd like to risk being incinerated in a nuclear war. In the State of New York, voters are disenfranchised without their knowledge, by the extremely challenging requirements to attain ballot status. Most voters have no idea how difficult it is to secure 45,000 valid signatures in six weeks, but wonder why there are so few viable candidates on the ballot. This outrageous task has forced my campaign to create a powerful team in the State of New York, so I've invited a few of the veterans from our petition drive to join me tonight to share their experience in interacting with hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers in order to be able to attain the objective. Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

name: Events Team via Our Revolution
subject: Starting now, Two MAJOR events! Tune in LIVE with Bernie at the Sanders Institute Gathering this weekend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, we have two
exciting events you won’t want to miss out on!

This weekend, Our Revolution will broadcast the Sanders Institute
Gathering LIVE from Vermont. Then, on June 11th, we’ll join the NLRB and
Economic Policy Institute for a LIVE virtual discussion on worker
organizing!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/773?t=1011&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ]TUNE IN WITH OUR REVOLUTION & BERNIE AT

THE SANDERS INSTITUTE GATHERING

Not only will Bernie Sanders be hitting the stage tonight, but he’ll be
joined by dozens of movement leaders throughout the weekend - including
Jane Sanders, author Bill McKibben, and Our Revolution’s own Joseph
Geevarghese - tackling all the major progressive issues that move our
movement forward.

Catch the live stream starting at 5:30 pm tonight (Friday) and continuing
through Sunday afternoon — on Our Revolution’s [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/773?t=1012&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ]Facebook and [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17923?t=1013&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ]Twitter
accounts!

Be sure to tune in at 9 am tomorrow morning (June 1) to hear Our
Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese speak on a panel about
Taking on Big Oil: Ending Fossil Fuel Subsidies with allies from Zero Hour
and Friends of the Earth.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17780?t=1014&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ][IMG]

We are looking forward to John Nichols of The Nation discussing the Role
of the Media in Effecting Change with David Sirota of The Lever and Jon
Queally of Common Dreams, and hear from Stephanie Kelton on her film:
Finding the Money.

And, on the topic of Fighting for the Working Class, we’ll hear from
exciting speakers like Sara Nelson, Int’l President Association of Flight
Attendants CWA, AFL-CIO, and Saru Jayaraman, President One Fair Wage.

Wendell Potter, author and whistleblower, will talk on the HealthCare
Crisis, and a host of other speakers will address a range of topics from
the Housing Crisis to Social Security.

Don’t miss out on this fun and inspiring weekend at the annual Sanders
Institute Gathering. Tune in on Our Revolution’s [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/773?t=1015&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ]Facebook or [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17923?t=1016&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ]Twitter
channels to catch the livestream!

WORKER ORGANIZING WITH NLRB

AND THE ECONOMIC POLICY INSTITUTE

Mark your calendar for June 11th!

Join Our Revolution for a LIVE discussion on worker organizing with the
Economic Policy Institute and new developments at the National Labor
Relations Board.

NLRB General Counsel Jennifer Abruzzo will give us a breakdown on all the
major reforms her office has undertaken. And, Our Revolution Chair Larry
Cohen will join her on a panel to discuss their impact on workplace
organizing.

We’ll learn about the measures the NLRB has taken to support workers'
organizing and bargaining rights under the Biden administration, and hear
from Cindy Estrada, Strategic Advisor to the President for the Center for
Transformational Organizing, AFL-CIO

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17924?t=1017&akid=6100%2E5885482%2EkeRzGT ]RSVP here to join at 2pm EST/11am PST on June 11th and lift up the
fight for worker power!

When we organize, we win!

Our Revolution

| | I’m glad I caught you before you break for the weekend, Peter. Midnight tonight means there’s just one month until we have to submit our next quarterly fundraising report to the FEC. Lots of people – from the GOP and special interests to our opponent – will look closely through our report to see if we have what it takes to win in IL-17 once again. We’re still coming up $1,679 short of our online fundraising goal. And with the stakes so high, I wouldn’t be doing right by my team or our supporters if I didn’t send one last email to try and meet this critical fundraising goal. Doing so would send a strong message that our grassroots support is stronger than ever. Will you rush in a donation before midnight to help us meet this monthly benchmark? Here’s a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q2-2024**](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/oLxO_-_C_81dZ3DrsyZ4Gw~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoPNLCP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_) Our fundraising goals aren’t random -- they’re the minimum amount we need in order to educate and engage the voters who will turn out and keep this competitive district blue. And as we head into summer, the weather isn’t the only thing heating up – so is our re-election campaign. We’ve seen the GOP ramp up their attacks against me, and Mike Johnson’s Super PAC has pledged at least $141 million to win targeted races like mine. You’ve been there when we needed you most. Right now, we’ll need all hands on deck as we weather another tough election. In a district this close, every grassroots contribution will make a difference. If you’re with me, chip in to give us a boost in this hyper-competitive race: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q2-2024**](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/oLxO_-_C_81dZ3DrsyZ4Gw~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoPNLCP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEyLTIwMjQ_) Thank you in advance for your support. -Eric

body:
We’ll be straightforward with you: with hours left before our end-of-month deadline, we’re coming to you with an important ask.
We’re going to lay out why a $5 contribution from you — especially before tonight’s deadline — would make a significant difference for our work together, but if you’re ready to chip in now, please make a contribution below to your personal link:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20240531-2?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28549?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20240531-6534-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6534%2E2526796%2EBFTs_8)
Here’s the work your contribution is funding:
* **Building resources to make local and community-focused impact:** From distributing thousands of backpacks across her district to make sure children started the school year off on the right foot, to raising over $60,000 in funds for relief efforts in Rafah _**just this week,**_ Alexandria has always been laser-focused on supporting communities.
* **Standing up for accountability in Congress:** Alexandria is the #2 Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, where she will continue to call out contractors and corporations for their gross misuse of taxpayer money. But with right-wing extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene on the same committee, Alexandria noted just how much harder holding these contractors accountable may become.

Alexandria can’t do this work alone — she needs a movement alongside her.
And when we’re able to post strong fundraising numbers, we're able to expand our movement, elect more progressive leaders, and keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for us all.
If you’re able, will you use your personal link below to make a $5 contribution before our end-of-month deadline at midnight tonight?
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20240531-2?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/28549?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20240531-6534-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6534%2E2526796%2EBFTs_8)
Together, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish.
Thank you,
Team AOC

Peter –
It’s official. The jury has spoken, justice was served, and Donald Trump is guilty on 34 felony counts in his New York criminal trial.
**[We’ll tell you how Fox News responded and why it matters in a moment, but we have a rapid goal of $5,000 to reach before midnight tonight to hit our May fundraising goal. Can you chip in $15 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86045874/476651330/-593472309?refcode=20240531-EM-TrumpTopper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDFhYjJlNzEtOWQxZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gAFsTtUgNteC_umpUdTfVw2iTladFMJUrmxxa9AFDTQ=)**
Fox News has been planting seeds to claim the trial was politically motivated since the beginning. **For example, in the early days of the trial, Fox News guests and personalities baselessly claimed at least 89 times that the jury selection process was rigged against President Trump. **
When the guilty verdict came in, things got downright dark:
* Primetime host Jesse Waters talked about his anger about the verdict, promising to “vanquish the evil forces that are destroying this republic.”
* Personality Jeanine Pirro suggested that Americans could react violently to the verdict because we are “fighters” and “revolution is in our DNA.”
* Fox News host Greg Gutfeld called the trial and the verdict a “conscious collusion of allies that came together with a private strategy to eliminate a common, shared adversary.”

Laura Ingraham called on viewers to “turn this dark day into a time to recommit yourself to saving America from these vindictive, far-left tyrants.”
We could go on and on, but you get the point: **Fox News is doing everything it can to prop up Trump, including turning its viewers against our judicial system by using incendiary rhetoric and baseless smears. **
So Fox News is being Fox News, so what?
**First,** we are a nation of laws, not of men. By smearing our judicial system as political and corrupt, Fox News is laying the groundwork for the authoritarian presidency that Trump is promising in his second term.
**Second,** Fox’s lies have a way of becoming the unimpeachable truth for millions of Americans. Thanks to Fox News and Trump, more than half of Republican voters now believe Democrats stole the 2020 election, even though there is zero evidence to support this claim.
**Third,** and most alarmingly, we’ve already seen political violence as a direct consequence of Fox’s pro-Trump rage-baiting and conspiracies. There would be no January 6th, 2021, without Fox News. They spread the lies that directly led to the assault on our Capitol.
So that’s the bad news – the good news is that COURIER is doing something to fight back. Right now, our ten battleground state newsrooms are working around the clock to correct right-wing misinformation from Fox News.
We post our trustworthy local news coverage in the same social media feeds and email inboxes where people are most likely to encounter Fox News and Donald Trump’s lies.
We also make all our news free to battleground state communities where misinformation could impact November’s election.

Hey Peter. It’s Ruben. One last email from me ahead of our deadline in a few hours.
I don’t want to undersell it: We’ve made a lot of progress today, but we’re still a good bit short of our goal. That breaks my heart, because so many people have already done so much.
So I have to ask, one last time: What can I say to convince you to make a donation before midnight?
Whether we win or lose is going to come down to whether or not we raise the resources we need.
Kari Lake is raking in millions from the billionaires, Trump’s MAGA supporters, AND the establishment GOP in Washington. They’re lining up batteries of attack ads and hitting us every single day.
But just about every single donation we receive comes from someone like you — someone who understands the stakes, understands we have zero margin for error to hold the Senate, understands how dangerous Kari Lake would be.
Someone who chips in what they can, when they can, to help us win.
It’s a lot of pressure. I know I’m feeling it, and you probably are, too. But together, we can do this. Really.

Tonight we’re coming up on our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we still have a ways to go before we reach our goal.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240531-2&t=1&akid=755%2E587540%2Eyqa9Cl)
Hi Peter, it's David.
Tonight we’re coming up on our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we still have a ways to go before we reach our goal. So before we hit midnight I wanted to reach out and explain why this work is so important.
With Trump on the ballot again and Republicans cracking down on fundamental rights all over the country, it’s no exaggeration to say that there’s a lot at stake for the future of our democracy this November.
**But whether Trump wins or loses, we need leaders in office who aren’t afraid to confront the rising tide of fascism in the Republican Party.**
**[Pitch in $5 →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240531-2?amount=5&refcode=em20240531-2-755&refcode2=755_587540_yqa9Cl&akid=755%2E587540%2Eyqa9Cl)**
Our strategy is to elect young leaders in key swing districts where our investments will pay off both in the short term and the long term — **by turning out young voters this election _and_ building a bench of future Democratic Party leaders.**
And here’s the good news: we’ve already scored some big wins by electing Nadarius Clark to the Virginia House of Delegates and Molly Cook to the Texas Senate!
But our biggest test yet is coming this November, and we need your help to replicate that success for the 13 candidates we’ve endorsed all over the country.
**[So Peter, please don't sit this one out. Pitch in $5 before midnight to help us reach our end-of-month goal and elect the Leaders We Deserve this Election Day.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240531-2?refcode=em20240531-2&amount=5&refcode2=755_587540_yqa9Cl&akid=755%2E587540%2Eyqa9Cl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240531-2?amount=5&refcode=em20240531-2-755&refcode2=755_587540_yqa9Cl&akid=755%2E587540%2Eyqa9Cl)**
**Also** our fundraising has been down because gmail changed their rules around spam with little notice so we have been landing in spam boxes more. That’s a problem for us because most of our funding comes from small dollar donors. (We’re working on fixing it but in the meantime there are two ways you can help with that. 1. Just open our emails even if you don’t donate. It helps tell gmail we are not spam. 2. If you want to make sure we get the support we need you can consider donating monthly (this helps a massive amount because small dollar fundraising has many booms and busts).
Thank you for everything you do,
David Hogg

Team,
Today, Colorado Governor Jared Polis signed into law a bill that will expand the Child Tax Credit in Colorado. This is a victory — one that could cut child poverty in half in our state.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_053124_EOM_B_ctc_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_053124_EOM_B_ctc_act] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_053124_EOM_B_ctc_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_053124_EOM_B_ctc_act] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_053124_EOM_B_ctc_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_053124_EOM_B_ctc_act]
I’ve fought to expand the Child Tax Credit at the federal level for years.
It’s a win-win policy. When Congress temporarily expanded the Child Tax Credit in 2021, it benefitted 62 million kids across the country, including 1 million in Colorado. It cut child poverty nationwide nearly in half.
Republicans in Congress let it expire after a year, but I haven’t given up the fight to make it permanent.
This common-sense policy gives working families the breathing room they need. It helps parents make ends meet and provide more opportunities for their kids.
Colorado is leading the way in creating an economy that works for everyone, not just the people at the top.
I’m working to make sure the rest of the country follows our lead.

# A message from Ro Khanna:

In less than 13 days, South Carolina primary voters will head to the polls. We need to make sure they pick Mal Hyman, a common-sense progressive, for Congress. There’s just one problem: Like me, Mal has pledged not to take a dime of corporate donations. That means he depends on grassroots donors like you and me to fuel his campaign to victory.
Let me tell you why I’m proud to support Mal for Congress. [But first, can you rush a donation to his campaign so he has the resources to win his primary?](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=f03132a001&e=5d7e9a146c)

* A living wage;
* Healthcare as a human right;

We need progressive champions like Mal in Congress who will prioritize working families and everyday Americans over special interests. But we can’t do it without your help.

Folks,

Republican National Committee (RNC) Chair Lara Trump made it clear what they think of our election process, and what they have planned for this year. She announced that the committee is aiming to recruit **100,000 volunteers** to “observe the voting process and report irregularities.”

Of course, voters can and should be able to see our elections in action. But we remember what happened last time election-deniers came to “observe” the process:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86047082/476656157/-209663063?refcode=em-5.31.24-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MzBkZGM4OS1hMTFmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FHd2jZ1HmaHggzhzK1xiMK05mXSV5-7JGCNwCTsRf6A=) __Frontline News: Aspiring poll watchers banged on the glass outside the room where absentee ballots were being counted at TCF Center on November 4, 2020, in Detroit, Michigan__
MAGA extremists weren’t there to calmly observe. They stormed ballot counting centers demanding election officials “STOP THE COUNT” and “STOP THE STEAL.” The RNC knows this, and they’re laying the groundwork for it to happen again.

They are building up their support now, and so are we.

name: Scott Baugh
subject: May Wrap-Up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Baugh for Congress
body:
|
---
| | [ ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=a7d91d309e&e=8a657725d1)
---
| Peter,

May was a month of meaningful connections, heartfelt honors, and steadfast commitment to our future. We dedicated ourselves to engaging with our community, celebrating the heroes of our past, and working tirelessly to secure a brighter future for all. From attending community events and honoring the sacrifices of our peace officers, to hosting roundtables and engaging young people in civic duties, every moment was a testament to our collective effort and shared vision. As we move forward, let's continue to unite, honor, and fight for the values that make our district and nation great.
---
| |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
**For National Law Enforcement Appreciation Week, Scott Baugh Team Members wanted to show their appreciation for the incredible men and women of law enforcement who keep our district safe. Thank you for the sacrifices you make, we hope you enjoy the donuts! And to everyone, whenever you see a member of law enforcement, let them know how much you appreciate the great work they do!**
|
---
**Celebrating the 20th anniversary of the Hoag OC Marathon was a truly special experience! As the founder of the OC Marathon Foundation, I was honored to be there, handing out medals to runners and witnessing the incredible community spirit. The Foundation has trained over 100,000 students on the importance of exercise and nutrition through its Kids Run, fostering lifelong healthy habits in our youth. The Hoag OC Marathon has also raised over $9 million for children's charities, positively impacting the lives of Orange County children in need. Thank you to all the participants, volunteers, and supporters who make the Kids Run such a successful and meaningful tradition!**
|
---
**To kick off Taiwanese American Heritage Week, it was an honor to attend the opening of the Taiwanese Cultural Center here in Orange County. Thank you to the Orange County Taiwanese Association, the Taiwanese Chamber of Commerce, and many more for hosting this event. One of our great allies around the world, it is important we support Taiwan’s rich history and culture, now and for the future.**
|
---
**It was an honor to attend the Black April Memorial. I want to thank Senator Janet Nguyen for her leadership in the community. May we continue to honor and remember the sacrifices made in the pursuit of freedom.**
|
---
**As we conclude a busy and productive May, I want to shine a spotlight on the heartbeat of our campaign: our amazing interns. Their dedication, hard work, and commitment to civic engagement have infused our team with energy and passion. They are the driving force behind our efforts, and their contributions are invaluable.** **We deeply appreciate everything our interns do to keep our campaign moving forward. Their enthusiasm and fresh perspectives are inspiring, reminding us why we are all here—to make a difference in our community.** **If you or someone you know is interested in joining our dynamic team and being a part of this exciting journey, we invite you to get involved. Visit our website to learn more and sign up. Together, we can continue to create positive change and build a brighter future.**
|
---
**One of the highlights of this month was hosting a call day for the HB3 candidates in Huntington Beach. It was an inspiring and energizing day, filled with meaningful conversations and a strong sense of community. Talking to both old and new friends, we united in our shared commitment to get this state back on track.** **The enthusiasm and dedication of everyone involved were truly uplifting. It's moments like these that remind us of the power of collective effort and the importance of coming together for a common cause.** **Thank you to everyone who participated and supported the HB3 candidates. Your involvement and passion are what drive us forward. Together, we can make a significant impact and create the positive change our community needs.**
|
---
**Everywhere I go, I meet supporters and constituents, and I’m inspired by the diverse and hardworking individuals I encounter. From all walks of life, we share a common thread of patriotism and a desire to shape a brighter future. Whether in CA-47 or beyond, your voices matter. Let’s unite, celebrate our differences, and work together to uphold the values that make us proud to be Americans!**
|
---
**I celebrated with many old and new friends at Israel Fest in Irvine this month. It was a lovely afternoon that amplified the richness and beauty of the Jewish community.

I can’t think of a more impactful time in generations when we all need to stand tall with the Jewish community. It was not lost on any of the attendees that Israel is at risk and that after the heinous October 7th attacks there are those who do not agree with Israel’s right to protect itself.**
|
---
**Thank you to Calico Fish House, Chef Andrew Gruel, the HB3, and all the wonderful people who came out for the Huntington Beach Meet and Greet. Your support means the world to us. Because of your hard work, the future is bright in HB!**
|
---
**This month, we hosted many dynamic phone bank events, encouraging students and volunteers to get involved in our campaign. It was an incredible opportunity for young people to learn about the voting process, gain hands-on experience, and grow through real campaign operations.** **The energy and enthusiasm from the students were infectious. They eagerly made calls, engaged with voters, and learned the ins and outs of grassroots campaigning. It's inspiring to see the next generation of leaders take an active role in shaping our future.** **We are grateful for their dedication and hard work. By participating in our campaign, these students are not only contributing to a vital cause but also building valuable skills and knowledge that will serve them well in their civic duties.** **Thank you to all the students who joined us. Your passion and involvement are what make our campaign stronger. Let's continue to empower and educate, paving the way for a brighter future together!**
|
---
**I spent a day with some of our district’s youngest constituents! Thank you Pretend City and Michelle Barto for the insightful tour. My mission in Congress is to protect our children's healthy and prosperous future. **
|
---
**This month, I had the privilege of attending a business roundtable hosted by the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) in Irvine. It was an enriching experience to connect with numerous local business owners and hear firsthand about the issues that matter most to them.

Our discussions covered a wide range of topics, from regulatory challenges to opportunities for growth and innovation. These conversations underscored the vital role that small businesses play in our community and the need for policies that support their success.

I am committed to advocating for the needs of our business community and ensuring that their voices are heard. Thank you to the NFIB for hosting this important event and to all the business owners who participated. Together, we can work towards a thriving economic future for our district.**
|
---
**I had the honor of attending a Peace Officer Memorial event, a poignant reminder of the bravery and sacrifice of our law enforcement officers. While our campaign trail is often filled with camaraderie and shared joy, it’s equally important to pause and reflect on the solemn moments. These heroes and their families have made immense sacrifices to uphold our safety and freedoms, ensuring we can continue to pursue the American dream we hold dear. Let’s cherish their memory and honor their legacy.**
|
---
**Across our community, the outpouring of support for our nation’s veterans was deeply moving, as we honored those who made the ultimate sacrifice on our behalf. We live in a district that understands our freedoms are not free, and we will continue the work to support all those who answer the call to defend.

Memorial Day was an opportunity to reflect on my own family, my grandfather who fought in the Battle of Normandy and the Battle of the Bulge, my great Uncle who was there at Pearl Harbor on December 7th, and my great friend Ben Klaffke who fought at Iwo Jima and Okinawa.

But it is also an opportunity to reconnect with many of the veterans of our district. Everywhere I went, Veterans had the same feedback. Our quality of care is nowhere near where it needs to be. We cannot ask individuals to make these sacrifices if we are not able to provide for them when they return. It is time we streamline our VA health care system, give veterans more access to community care, and increase the standards at the VA. This is how we honor and serve those who have served us, everyday.**

| | Team,

Yesterday we witnessed history and another dark moment for our country. Like many, I have continued to hope for a breaking point and a return to sanity for the Republican Party.

But since the news broke, the former President’s supporters and enablers in Congress have rallied behind him with more fervor than we have ever seen before.

Within minutes, the Republican’s online fundraising platform CRASHED due to an influx of donations to his campaign and in support of efforts to give him majorities in the House and Senate.

This is what we’re up against right now, folks.
